c00_001_018.stx.en: Nothing.
No light. No sound.
No form. No voice.
No knowledge of who I am.
...Who I am?
Who am I?
I extend a hand.
A hand that belongs to no one.
c00_001_018.stx.es: Una mano que no le pertenece a nadie.

c00_001_018.stx.en: To take hold of my existence—
This is me.
My name is Kaede Akamatsu.
I just remembered who I am.
Nice to meet...me.
I'm the protagonist of this crazy story.
c00_001_018.stx.es: Soy la protagonista de esta loca historia.

c00_001_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I stumbled out of the locker in a daze.
But as soon as I did...
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Salí del casillero tambaleándome, aturdida.
Pero en cuanto lo hice...

c00_001_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>...I fell on the floor.
Ahh!?

<CLT=cltMIND>I couldn't even brace for impact as
blinding pain suddenly rushed through my head.
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Ni siquiera pude prepararme para el golpe
cuando un dolor cegador me atravesó la cabeza.

c00_001_018.stx.en: Gghhh... Owww...

<CLT=cltMIND>But thanks to that pain, I went from
dazed to annoyed real quick.
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Pero gracias a ese dolor, pasé de estar
aturdida a molesta en un instante.

c00_001_018.stx.en: ...Huh? Wait, where am I? What is this place?

<CLT=cltMIND>I rubbed my throbbing forehead.
Yep, this is definitely going to leave a bump...
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Me froté la frente adolorida.
Sí, esto definitivamente me va a dejar un chichón...

c00_001_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>I looked around.
...A classroom?

<CLT=cltMIND>Yeah, this is a classroom alright.
But...I don't recognize it.
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Sí, sin duda es un salón de clases.
Pero...no lo reconozco.

c00_001_018.stx.en:
Where am I...?
What am I doing here...?

Oh! Is this a dream!?
I just have to pinch myself, right?
c00_001_018.stx.es:
¡Ah! ¡¿Esto es un sueño?!
Solo tengo que pellizcarme, ¿verdad?

c00_001_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>So I pinched my cheek...

<CLT=cltMIND>...but all that did was make my head hurt
in two places instead of one.
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>...pero lo único que logré fue que me doliera
en dos lugares en vez de uno.

c00_001_018.stx.en:
Ummm... Okay, hold on a sec. Let's just stay calm
and think this through.
c00_001_018.stx.es:
Mmm... A ver, espera un segundo. Hay que
mantener la calma y pensarlo bien.

c00_001_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Confused as I was, I tried to remember
how I ended up here.
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Aunque estaba confundida, traté de recordar
cómo había terminado aquí.

c00_001_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>But no matter how hard I tried,
in the end I just couldn't—
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Pero por más que lo intenté,
al final simplemente no pude—

c00_001_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>*bam!*
Whoa!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>Suddenly, the locker next to mine started
swaying and shaking, making all kinds of noise.
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>De repente, el casillero junto al mío empezó
a sacudirse y a temblar, haciendo mucho ruido.

c00_001_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>As I fearfully turned around, the locker door
slowly opened and...
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Cuando me di la vuelta con miedo, la puerta
del casillero se abrió lentamente y...

c00_001_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>...a boy came stumbling out.
Hnnng...

<CLT=cltMIND>A normal boy dressed in a school uniform...
In fact, he might be a high school student, too.
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Un chico normal con uniforme escolar...
De hecho, quizá también vaya a la preparatoria.

c00_001_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>He looked bewildered, and when he slowly
lifted his head...
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Se veía desconcertado, y cuando levantó
la cabeza lentamente...

c00_001_018.stx.en: ...Ah! Aaugh!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>He screamed as if he'd just seen a monster,
fell on his butt, and scooted back.
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Gritó como si hubiera visto un monstruo,
se cayó de sentón y se arrastró hacia atrás.

c00_001_018.stx.en:
Wh-Who are you!? Are you with those
<CLT=cltSTRONG>other guys<CLT=cltNORMAL>!?
...What other guys?
The people who kidnapped me!
Kidnapped?

Wh-Where am I...?
What are you gonna do to me!?
Hey! Hold on!
<CLT=cltMIND>I firmly gripped his shoulders...
What's your name?
...Huh?
Ah, I'm...Shuichi Saihara.

I'm Kaede Akamatsu.
Now listen to me, Shuichi...
c00_001_018.stx.es:
Yo soy Kaede Akamatsu.
Ahora escúchame, Shuichi...

c00_001_018.stx.en:
Shut up! You're not the only one who's
confused right now!
c00_001_018.stx.es:
¡Cállate! ¡No eres el único que está
confundido ahora mismo!

c00_001_018.stx.en: Ah, sorry...

<CLT=cltMIND>After making him shut up, I retraced
my steps again.
c00_001_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Después de hacerlo callar, volví a repasar
lo que había pasado.

c00_001_018.stx.en: ...That's right.
I was kidnapped, too!

I was walking my usual route to school when
all of a sudden, someone shoved me into a car.
c00_001_018.stx.es:
Iba a la escuela por mi camino de siempre
cuando de repente alguien me metió a un auto.

c00_001_018.stx.en:
I shouted for help, but no one came
to rescue me...
c00_001_018.stx.es:
Grité pidiendo ayuda, pero nadie
vino a rescatarme...

c00_001_018.stx.en:
Everyone pretended like nothing happened...
It made me think how rotten the world is...
c00_001_018.stx.es:
Todos fingieron que no pasaba nada...
Me hizo pensar en lo podrido que está el mundo...

c00_001_018.stx.en: And then, I lost consciousness...
And when I woke up, I was inside that locker...
c00_001_018.stx.es: Y al despertar, estaba dentro de ese casillero...

c00_001_018.stx.en:
Same with me...
Were we kidnapped by the same people?
c00_001_018.stx.es:
A mí me pasó lo mismo...
¿Nos habrá secuestrado la misma gente?

c00_001_018.stx.en: It seems like it...
But...why me?

My family's not rich and I'm no one special.
I'm just a normal high school girl.
c00_001_018.stx.es:
Mi familia no es rica y no soy nadie especial.
Solo soy una chica de preparatoria normal.

c00_001_018.stx.en: There's no reason to kidnap me...

Me either...
I'm just a regular guy...
c00_001_018.stx.es:
Yo tampoco...
Solo soy un chico común y corriente...

c00_001_018.stx.en:
And...this is a school, right?
Why did they take us to a school?
c00_001_018.stx.es:
Y...esto es una escuela, ¿no?
¿Por qué nos traerían a una escuela?

c00_001_018.stx.en: I wonder why...

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Hey there. I'm sure you're confused
right now. You're thinking, "Where am I...?"
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Hola. Seguro que todo esto te confunde.
Estás pensando: "¿Dónde estoy...?"

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Well, I can't explain that, but I can
give a basic explanation about the controls.
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Bueno, eso no te lo puedo explicar, pero
sí te puedo explicar lo básico de los controles.

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Use the <PAD=【Ｌ３】> stick to control
the reticle on the screen.
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Usa el stick <PAD=【Ｌ３】> para controlar
la mira en la pantalla.

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When you have a target in your sights,
press the <PAD=【○】> button to investigate it.
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Cuando tengas un objetivo en la mira,
presiona el botón <PAD=【○】> para investigarlo.

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The <PAD=【Ｒ３】> stick controls your view.
Get a good look at your surroundings.
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>El stick <PAD=【Ｒ３】> controla la cámara.
Observa bien lo que te rodea.

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can also press the <PAD=【Ｒ１】> button
to smack objects around.
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>También puedes presionar el botón <PAD=【Ｒ１】>
para darles golpes a los objetos.

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Who knows?
You might find something amazing.
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>¿Quién sabe?
Podrías encontrar algo increíble.

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can always press the <PAD=【Ｌ１】> button to return
objects to their original position, so relax.
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Siempre puedes presionar el botón <PAD=【Ｌ１】> para
devolver los objetos a su lugar, así que tranquilo.

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>However, not every object can be moved.
Thank you for understanding.
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Sin embargo, no todos los objetos se pueden
mover. Gracias por tu comprensión.

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If you press the <PAD=【△】> button, a
mysterious investigative power will activate...
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Si presionas el botón <PAD=【△】>, se activará
un misterioso poder de investigación...

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Sorry, I know this is a
lot of information.
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Perdón, sé que es
mucha información.

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>But if you forget anything, you can press the
<PAD=【Ｆ㊨】> button to review the controls.
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Pero si olvidas algo, puedes presionar el
botón <PAD=【Ｆ㊨】> para repasar los controles.

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Investigate this place thoroughly!
That's how you progress the story, y'know?
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>¡Investiga este lugar a fondo!
Así es como avanza la historia, ¿sabes?

c00_002_018.stx.en:
Anyway, let's just stay calm and think.
I'm sorry I shouted at you earlier.
c00_002_018.stx.es:
En fin, mantengamos la calma y pensemos.
Perdón por gritarte hace rato.

c00_002_018.stx.en: Ah, no, it's okay...
c00_002_018.stx.es: Ah, no, está bien...

c00_002_018.stx.en: I shouldn't have yelled at you.
c00_002_018.stx.es: No debí gritarte.

c00_002_018.stx.en:
Anyway, this place is...weird. You don't think
we got caught up in something bad, do you?
c00_002_018.stx.es:
En fin, este lugar es...raro. ¿No crees que
nos metimos en algo malo?

c00_002_018.stx.en: Something bad...
c00_002_018.stx.es: Algo malo...

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>What's going on? What have we gotten
ourselves into?
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Qué está pasando? ¿En qué nos
hemos metido?

c00_002_018.stx.en:
This place is...weird. You don't think we
got caught up in something bad, do you?
c00_002_018.stx.es:
Este lugar es...raro. ¿No crees que nos
metimos en algo malo?

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You should fully investigate this area
first.
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Primero deberías investigar a fondo
esta zona.

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>That's a blackboard, right?
Every classroom has one, but...
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Eso es un pizarrón, ¿no?
Todos los salones tienen uno, pero...

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This blackboard is also an LCD screen.
That's something you don't see every day...
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Este pizarrón también es una pantalla LCD.
Eso no se ve todos los días...

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This blackboard is also an LCD screen.
That's something you don't see every day...
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Este pizarrón también es una pantalla LCD.
Eso no se ve todos los días...

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>The outside of the window is covered in greenery
...and barbed wire?
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Del otro lado de la ventana hay vegetación
...¿y alambre de púas?

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Why are the school windows covered in
barbed wire?
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Por qué las ventanas de la escuela están
cubiertas de alambre de púas?

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Why are the school windows covered in
barbed wire?
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Por qué las ventanas de la escuela están
cubiertas de alambre de púas?

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Where am I? Why was I kidnapped?
Who kidnapped me?
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Dónde estoy? ¿Por qué me secuestraron?
¿Quién me secuestró?

c00_002_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>I don't understand this at all...
c00_002_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>No entiendo nada de esto...

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>But that doesn't matter!
At least, for now...
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¡Pero eso no importa!
Al menos, por ahora...

c00_002_018.stx.en:
Hey, let's just get out of here as fast as we
can and find some help!
c00_002_018.stx.es:
¡Oye, salgamos de aquí lo más rápido que
podamos y busquemos ayuda!

c00_002_018.stx.en: Y-Yeah... Good idea!
c00_002_018.stx.es: S-Sí... ¡Buena idea!

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We ran as fast as we could to the classroom
door, and opened it with all our strength...
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Corrimos lo más rápido que pudimos a la puerta
del salón y la abrimos con todas las fuerzas...

c00_002_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>But then—
c00_002_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Pero entonces—

c00_002_018.stx.en: Hell yeah! Found you!
c00_002_018.stx.es: ¡Hell yeah! ¡Los encontré!

c00_002_018.stx.en: What?
c00_002_018.stx.es: ¿Qué?

c00_002_018.stx.en: A m-monster!?
c00_002_018.stx.es: ¡¿Un m-monstruo?!

c00_002_018.stx.en: Gah-hahahaha! Woooo! Hahaha!
c00_002_018.stx.es: ¡Gah-jajajaja! ¡Wuuuu! ¡Jajaja!

c00_002_018.stx.en: Th-This is bad! We need to get out of here!
c00_002_018.stx.es: ¡E-Esto es malo! ¡Tenemos que salir de aquí!

c00_002_018.stx.en: O-Okay!
c00_002_018.stx.es: ¡E-Está bien!

c00_002_018.stx.en:
Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait, wait, wait, wait,
wait, wait, waaaaait!!!
c00_002_018.stx.es:
¡¡¡Espera, espera, espera, espera, espera, espera,
espera, espera, espera, esperaaaaa!!!

c00_002_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>We woke up inside of these lockers...
c00_002_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Despertamos dentro de estos casilleros...

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>But why were we in these lockers
in the first place?
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Pero ¿por qué estábamos en estos casilleros
en primer lugar?

c00_002_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>We woke up inside of these lockers...
c00_002_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Despertamos dentro de estos casilleros...

c00_002_018.stx.en:
Why were we put inside lockers?
I don't understand...
c00_002_018.stx.es:
¿Por qué nos metieron en casilleros?
No entiendo...

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Is this a monitor?
Nothing's being displayed right now...
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Esto es un monitor?
Ahora mismo no muestra nada...

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Seriously though, what is it?
It really seems out of place here.
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>En serio, ¿qué es esto?
Se ve totalmente fuera de lugar aquí.

c00_002_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This monitor is way too high-tech to be
used in a school...
c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Este monitor es demasiado avanzado para
usarse en una escuela...

c00_002_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Hola. Seguro que todo esto te confunde.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Cuando tengas un objetivo en la mira,

c00_003_001.stx.en: Ah, geez! What are those things!?
Don't go that way! Over here!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>As we frantically dove toward
the door, we saw...
c00_004_007.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Mientras nos lanzábamos desesperados
hacia la puerta, vimos...

c00_004_007.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>...something we never expected to see.
c00_004_007.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>...algo que jamás esperábamos ver.

c00_004_007.stx.en: Ohhh... More people have arrived.
c00_004_007.stx.es: Ohhh... Llegó más gente.

c00_004_007.stx.en: Huh?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿Eh?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Did you all get chased by 
that monster, too!?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡¿A ustedes también los persiguió 
ese monstruo?!

c00_004_007.stx.en: O-Oh, yeah...
c00_004_007.stx.es: A-Ah, sí...

c00_004_007.stx.en:
What...are they? 
What do they want with us?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¿Qué...son esas cosas? 
¿Qué quieren de nosotros?

c00_004_007.stx.en: Do you want me to check on what's happening?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿Quieren que vaya a ver qué está pasando?

c00_004_007.stx.en: You can't! It's too dangerous out there!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡No puedes! ¡Allá afuera es muy peligroso!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
It's likely that monster 
still lurks nearby...
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Es probable que ese monstruo 
siga merodeando cerca...

c00_004_007.stx.en: W-Wait!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡E-Esperen!

c00_004_007.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>I shouted at the top of my lungs.
c00_004_007.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Grité con todas mis fuerzas.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Who are you guys...?
And why am I here—
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¿Quiénes son ustedes...?
¿Y por qué estoy aquí—

c00_004_007.stx.en: And that makes 16.
c00_004_007.stx.es: Y con eso somos 16.

c00_004_007.stx.en: What?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿Qué?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
I'm talking about us.
There are 16 of us—all high schoolers.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Hablo de nosotros.
Somos 16, todos estudiantes de preparatoria.

c00_004_007.stx.en: What do you think that means?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿Qué crees que significa eso?

c00_004_007.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>16...high schoolers...?
c00_004_007.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>¿16...estudiantes de preparatoria...?

c00_004_007.stx.en: Oh, right. Didn't answer your question.
c00_004_007.stx.es: Ah, cierto. No respondí tu pregunta.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
I can give you my name.
It's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Rantaro Amami<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Te puedo decir mi nombre.
Es <CLT=cltSTRONG>Rantaro Amami<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_004_007.stx.en: Let's leave it at that for now.
c00_004_007.stx.es: Dejémoslo así por ahora.

c00_004_007.stx.en: Huh? Um...okay.
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿Eh? Mmm...está bien.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Anyway, why does it matter if there are 
16 of us? There might be more coming.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
En fin, ¿qué importa que seamos 
16? Puede que lleguen más.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Nah, I think this is all of us.
<CLT=cltSTRONG>If this is what I think it is<CLT=cltNORMAL>, anyway.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Nah, creo que ya estamos todos.
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Si esto es lo que creo que es<CLT=cltNORMAL>, claro.

c00_004_007.stx.en: ...If this is what you think it is?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ...¿Si esto es lo que crees que es?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
What, you some kinda fuckin' know-it-all?
If you know somethin', spit it out!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¿Qué, eres un maldito sabelotodo o qué?
¡Si sabes algo, escúpelo!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>It was at that moment... An unknown voice
suddenly echoed throughout the gym.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Fue en ese momento... Una voz desconocida
resonó de repente por todo el gimnasio.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Okayyyyy, quiet everyone!
Shimmy down, shimmy down!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Bueeeno, silencio todos!
¡Silencio en la salsa, silencio en la salsa!

c00_004_007.stx.en: No, no, no. It's "<CLT=cltSTRONG>simmer down<CLT=cltNORMAL>."
c00_004_007.stx.es: No, no, no. Es "<CLT=cltSTRONG>silencio en la sala<CLT=cltNORMAL>".

c00_004_007.stx.en: Huh? Who's that? Where are they?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿Eh? ¿Quién dijo eso? ¿Dónde están?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Kyahahahahaha! 
Thanks for bearing with us!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Kyajajajajaja! 
¡Gracias por su paciencia!

c00_004_007.stx.en: AAAAAAHHHH!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡¡¡AAAAAAHHHH!!!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Damn it! There are more monsters!
We're surrounded!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Maldición! ¡Hay más monstruos!
¡Estamos rodeados!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
These aren't monsters.
They're <CLT=cltSTRONG>Exisals<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
No son monstruos.
Son <CLT=cltSTRONG>Exisals<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
They're <CLT=cltSTRONG>highly mobile, bipedal weapons
platforms<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Son <CLT=cltSTRONG>plataformas de armas bípedas
de alta movilidad<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_004_007.stx.en: Weapons!?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡¿Armas?!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Should we take these for a spin by killin'
one of 'em!?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡¿Y si las estrenamos matando
a uno de ellos?!

c00_004_007.stx.en: Gyaaaahhh!!! Wait a minute!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡¡¡Gyaaaahhh!!! ¡Espera un momento!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
It wouldn't be any fun picking on plain,
good-for-nothing commoners!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡No tendría gracia meterse con simples
plebeyos buenos para nada!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
You're right. We should at least think of
an interesting way to kill you.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Tienes razón. Al menos deberíamos pensar
en una forma interesante de matarlos.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Maybe I'll pick ya up and squeeze ya till
your guts come gushin' out like toothpaste!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Tal vez te agarre y te apriete hasta que
las tripas te salgan como pasta de dientes!

c00_004_007.stx.en: P-Please! Not like toothpaste!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡P-Por favor! ¡Como pasta de dientes no!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Urgh... I just imagined it.
I can't handle gore.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Urgh... Me lo acabo de imaginar.
No soporto las cosas sangrientas.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Then what if...we start peelin' off their limbs
one by one, like string cheese?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Entonces, ¿y si...les arrancamos las extremidades
una por una, como queso de hebra?

c00_004_007.stx.en: Please, not like string cheese either!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡Por favor, como queso de hebra tampoco!

c00_004_007.stx.en: Wait! We can't kill them with the Exisals.
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡Esperen! No podemos matarlos con los Exisals.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
According to the schedule, the Exisals
aren't supposed to show up till later!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Según el programa, los Exisals no
deben aparecer hasta más adelante!

c00_004_007.stx.en: But...we're in the Exisals right now.
c00_004_007.stx.es: Pero...ahora mismo estamos en los Exisals.

c00_004_007.stx.en: Oh! So we are!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡Oh! ¡Es cierto!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
We screwed up. We're not supposed to be
in the Exisals for our first appearance.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Metimos la pata. No debíamos salir en los
Exisals en nuestra primera aparición.

c00_004_007.stx.en: I told ya we shoulda read the script!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡Les dije que teníamos que leer el guion!

c00_004_007.stx.en: ...No, ya didn't.
c00_004_007.stx.es: ...No, no lo dijiste.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Well...why don't we just get out of these
mechs? It shouldn't be too late for that.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Bueno...¿por qué no nos bajamos de estos
robots? Todavía estamos a tiempo.

c00_004_007.stx.en: Y-Yeah! Let's do that!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡S-Sí! ¡Hagámoslo!

c00_004_007.stx.en: Okay, readyyyy!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡Muy bien, listooos!

c00_004_007.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>...
c00_004_007.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>...

c00_004_007.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>...Huh?
c00_004_007.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>...¿Eh?

c00_004_007.stx.en: See? We're outta the Exisals.
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿Ven? Ya salimos de los Exisals.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Now we're not scary anymore, right?
Right? Right!?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Ya no damos miedo, ¿verdad?
¿Verdad? ¡¿Verdad?!

c00_004_007.stx.en: His desperation is strangely terrifying...!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡Su desesperación es extrañamente aterradora...!

c00_004_007.stx.en: You punkasses better brace yourselves!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡Más les vale prepararse, pedazos de basura!

c00_004_007.stx.en: And he's just outright terrifying!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡Y él es aterrador y punto!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
I'm a messenger from hell from the depths
of hell, here to drag ya down to hell!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Soy un mensajero del infierno de lo profundo
del infierno, aquí para arrastrarlos al infierno!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
No, no, Monokid. You're sayin' "hell" too
much. It's ruining the hellish impact!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
No, no, Monokid. Dices "infierno" demasiadas
veces. ¡Arruinas el impacto infernal!

c00_004_007.stx.en: Eh? What's hellish mean?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿Eh? ¿Qué significa infernal?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
H-Hey...what's up with these stuffed
animals? How are they moving?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
O-Oigan...¿qué pasa con estos peluches?
¿Cómo es que se mueven?

c00_004_007.stx.en: I-I have no idea.
c00_004_007.stx.es: N-No tengo idea.

c00_004_007.stx.en: Moving stuffed animals...
c00_004_007.stx.es: Peluches que se mueven...

c00_004_007.stx.en:
On top of that, it seems like they're calling
themselves the "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Monokubs<CLT=cltNORMAL>."
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Además, parece que se hacen llamar
los "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Monokubs<CLT=cltNORMAL>".

c00_004_007.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Moving stuffed animals?
Monokubs?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Peluches que se mueven?
¿Monokubs?

c00_004_007.stx.en: Wait! You guys call yourselves...the Monokubs?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡Esperen! ¿Ustedes se llaman...los Monokubs?

c00_004_007.stx.en: Oh... Don't bother askin' Monodam.
c00_004_007.stx.es: Oh... Ni te molestes en preguntarle a Monodam.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
He only talks to close friends. The years of
abuse have really done a number on his heart.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Solo les habla a sus amigos cercanos. Los años
de maltrato le dejaron el corazón hecho pedazos.

c00_004_007.stx.en: Isn't that right, Monodam?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿No es así, Monodam?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
M-Monodam! You won't even open your
heart...to me!?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡M-Monodam! ¡¿Ni siquiera a mí...me abres
el corazón?!

c00_004_007.stx.en: Looks like I was right.
c00_004_007.stx.es: Parece que tenía razón.

c00_004_007.stx.en: This is exactly <CLT=cltSTRONG>what I thought it was<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_004_007.stx.es: Esto es exactamente <CLT=cltSTRONG>lo que pensé que era<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
But who's behind all this?
Why the ridiculous theatrics—
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Pero ¿quién está detrás de todo esto?
¿Por qué tanto teatro ridículo—

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Gahhh! Shut up, you! All o' you are reactin'
way too normally to this! It's boring!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Gahhh! ¡Cállate! ¡Todos reaccionan de forma
demasiado normal a esto! ¡Qué aburrido!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Actually...don't their clothes seem kinda
boring, too?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
En realidad...¿no les parece que su ropa
también es medio aburrida?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Wait a minute... Ya think maybe they haven't
been given their <CLT=cltSTRONG>first memory<CLT=cltNORMAL> yet?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Espera un momento... ¿Crees que todavía no les
han dado su <CLT=cltSTRONG>primer recuerdo<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Huh? That shoulda happened before they
woke up...
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¿Eh? Eso debió pasar antes de que
despertaran...

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Hey, answer my question!
If you guys are the Monokubs, then—
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Oye, responde mi pregunta!
Si ustedes son los Monokubs, entonces—

c00_004_007.stx.en: Hey! Who the hell are you punks!?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡Oigan! ¡¿Quiénes demonios son, mocosos?!

c00_004_007.stx.en: Huh?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿Eh?

c00_004_007.stx.en: What do you mean?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿A qué te refieres?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
We're just wondering...do youse guys have
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate talents<CLT=cltNORMAL> or anything like that?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Solo nos preguntábamos...¿ustedes tienen
<CLT=cltSTRONG>talentos Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL> o algo así?

c00_004_007.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>Ultimate talents...?
c00_004_007.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>¿Talentos Definitivos...?

c00_004_007.stx.en: I...don't have one.
c00_004_007.stx.es: Yo...no tengo uno.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
I have a skill that I devote myself to...but
I wouldn't call it an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate talent<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Tengo una habilidad a la que me dedico...pero
no lo llamaría un <CLT=cltSTRONG>talento Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

c00_004_007.stx.en:
M-Me either...
I-I don't...have anything like that...
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Y-Yo tampoco...
Y-Yo no...tengo nada así...

c00_004_007.stx.en: Y-Yeah...same here.
c00_004_007.stx.es: S-Sí...yo igual.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
I knew it! They haven't gotten their <CLT=cltSTRONG>first
memory<CLT=cltNORMAL> yet!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Lo sabía! ¡Todavía no les dan su <CLT=cltSTRONG>primer
recuerdo<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

c00_004_007.stx.en: Monophanie...weren't you in charge of that?
c00_004_007.stx.es: Monophanie...¿no estabas tú a cargo de eso?

c00_004_007.stx.en: zzzzz...
c00_004_007.stx.es: zzzzz...

c00_004_007.stx.en:
She's sleeping? Did she seem really tired
to you guys?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¿Está dormida? ¿Les pareció que estaba
muy cansada?

c00_004_007.stx.en: She's obviously fakin' it.
c00_004_007.stx.es: Es obvio que está fingiendo.

c00_004_007.stx.en: zzzzzzzzz...
c00_004_007.stx.es: zzzzzzzzz...

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Even if she's faking, she looks so peaceful.
Let's whisper so we don't wake her up.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Aunque esté fingiendo, se ve tan tranquila.
Hablemos bajito para no despertarla.

c00_004_007.stx.en: Hmph! If you say so!
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡Hmph! ¡Si tú lo dices!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
A-Anyway...if you guys really are the
Monokubs, then—
c00_004_007.stx.es:
E-En fin...si ustedes de verdad son los
Monokubs, entonces—

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Don't worry about us. The real issue is
youse bastards.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
No se preocupen por nosotros. El problema
son ustedes, bastardos.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Well, "issue" is putting it mildly...
This is actually a huge problem.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Bueno, decir "problema" es quedarse corto...
Esto en realidad es un problemón.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Youse all have forgotten your talents and
become generic high school students.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Todos ustedes olvidaron sus talentos y se
volvieron estudiantes de preparatoria genéricos.

c00_004_007.stx.en: Huh? Forgotten?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿Eh? ¿Olvidamos?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
See, according to the backstory, there's
this <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL> goin' on.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Verán, según la historia de fondo, está
pasando una <CLT=cltSTRONG>Cacería de Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
You've all lost your memories and become
different people cuz of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Por la <CLT=cltSTRONG>Cacería de Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL>, todos
perdieron la memoria y ahora son otras personas.

c00_004_007.stx.en: Umm...what are you talking about?
c00_004_007.stx.es: Mmm...¿de qué están hablando?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Well, in your current state, it's pretty much
pointless to talk to you guys about this.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Bueno, tal como están ahora, no tiene
mucho caso hablarles de esto.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
The first thing we need you guys to do is
remember your <CLT=cltSTRONG>true selves<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Lo primero que necesitamos es que
recuerden su <CLT=cltSTRONG>verdadero yo<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Yeah! You need to reclaim your <CLT=cltSTRONG>sealed talents<CLT=cltNORMAL>
by regaining your memories!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Sí! ¡Tienen que recuperar sus <CLT=cltSTRONG>talentos sellados<CLT=cltNORMAL>
recuperando sus recuerdos!

c00_004_007.stx.en: What the—!? Are you awake already?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¡¿Qué rayos—?! ¿Ya despertaste?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
I don't get it... What are these <CLT=cltSTRONG>sealed talents<CLT=cltNORMAL>
you're talking about?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
No entiendo... ¿Qué son esos <CLT=cltSTRONG>talentos sellados<CLT=cltNORMAL>
de los que hablan?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
How are we supposed to talk when you
keep askin' so many friggin' questions!?
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡¿Cómo vamos a hablar si no dejas
de hacer tantas malditas preguntas?!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Yeah! We're not some swift-footed singer
who's landed another future ex-boyfriend!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Sí! ¡No somos una cantante veloz que ya
consiguió a su próximo exnovio!

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Let's do this already. No one wants to watch
a bunch of generic high school whiners.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Acabemos con esto. Nadie quiere ver a un
montón de estudiantes genéricos quejándose.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
First, we'll update your wardrobe so you
guys look all cute and spiffy!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Primero, vamos a renovar su ropa para
que se vean lindos y elegantes!

c00_004_007.stx.en: H-Huh? Wh-What am I wearing?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿E-Eh? ¿Q-Qué traigo puesto?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Mm-hm! Looking good! Now you look more
like <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Mm-hm! ¡Se ven bien! Ahora sí parecen
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_004_007.stx.en: <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL>...? Really?
c00_004_007.stx.es: ¿<CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL>...? ¿En serio?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Next up, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>memory<CLT=cltNORMAL> youse all been
waiting for.
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Y ahora, el <CLT=cltSTRONG>recuerdo<CLT=cltNORMAL> que todos
estaban esperando.

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Hell yeah! Get ready! Once the seal is broken,
we'll be in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>domain of the killing game<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Hell yeah! ¡Prepárense! Al romperse el sello,
¡entraremos al <CLT=cltSTRONG>dominio del juego de matanza<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

c00_004_007.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>K-Killing game...?
c00_004_007.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>¿J-Juego de matanza...?

c00_004_007.stx.en:
Now then, after the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL> helps
you remember your <CLT=cltSTRONG>amazing talents<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
c00_004_007.stx.es:
Bueno, después de que la <CLT=cltSTRONG>Luz de Recuerdos<CLT=cltNORMAL>
los ayude a recordar sus <CLT=cltSTRONG>increíbles talentos<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

c00_004_007.stx.en:
This <CLT=cltSTRONG>amazing story<CLT=cltNORMAL> will begin for real
this time!
c00_004_007.stx.es:
¡Esta <CLT=cltSTRONG>increíble historia<CLT=cltNORMAL> comenzará de verdad
esta vez!

c00_005_018.stx.en: H-Huh...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I stumbled out of the locker in a daze.
But as soon as I did...
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Salí del casillero tambaleándome, aturdida.
Pero en cuanto lo hice...

c00_005_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>...I fell on the floor.
c00_005_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>...me caí al suelo.

c00_005_018.stx.en: Ahh!?
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¡¿Aah?!

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I couldn't even brace for impact as
blinding pain suddenly rushed through my head.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Ni siquiera pude prepararme para el golpe
cuando un dolor cegador me atravesó la cabeza.

c00_005_018.stx.en: Gghhh... Owww...
c00_005_018.stx.es: Ggh... Aaay...

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>But thanks to that pain, I went from
dazed to annoyed real quick.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Pero gracias a ese dolor, pasé de estar
aturdida a molesta en un instante.

c00_005_018.stx.en: ...Huh? Wait, where am I? What is this place?
c00_005_018.stx.es: ...¿Eh? Espera, ¿dónde estoy? ¿Qué es este lugar?

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I rubbed my throbbing forehead.
Yep, this is definitely going to leave a bump...
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Me froté la frente adolorida.
Sí, esto definitivamente me va a dejar un chichón...

c00_005_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>I looked around.
c00_005_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Miré a mi alrededor.

c00_005_018.stx.en: ...A classroom?
c00_005_018.stx.es: ...¿Un salón de clases?

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Yeah, this is a classroom alright.
But...I don't recognize it.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Sí, sin duda es un salón de clases.
Pero...no lo reconozco.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Where am I...?
What am I doing here...?
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¿Dónde estoy...?
¿Qué hago aquí...?

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Oh! Is this a dream!?
I just have to pinch myself, right?
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡Ah! ¡¿Esto es un sueño?!
Solo tengo que pellizcarme, ¿verdad?

c00_005_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>So I pinched my cheek...
c00_005_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Así que me pellizqué la mejilla...

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>...but all that did was make my head hurt
in two places instead of one.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>...pero lo único que logré fue que me doliera
en dos lugares en vez de uno.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Ummm... Okay, hold on a sec. Let's just stay calm
and think this through.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
Mmm... A ver, espera un segundo. Hay que
mantener la calma y pensarlo bien.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Confused as I was, I tried to remember
how I ended up here.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Aunque estaba confundida, traté de recordar
cómo había terminado aquí.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>But no matter how hard I tried,
in the end I just couldn't—
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Pero por más que lo intenté,
al final simplemente no pude—

c00_005_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>*bam!*
c00_005_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>¡Pum!

c00_005_018.stx.en: Whoa!!!
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¡¡¡Waaa!!!

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Suddenly, the locker next to mine started
swaying and shaking, making all kinds of noise.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>De repente, el casillero junto al mío empezó
a sacudirse y a temblar, haciendo mucho ruido.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>As I fearfully turned around, the locker door
slowly opened and...
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Cuando me di la vuelta con miedo, la puerta
del casillero se abrió lentamente y...

c00_005_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>...a boy came stumbling out.
c00_005_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>...un chico salió tambaleándose.

c00_005_018.stx.en: Hnnng...
c00_005_018.stx.es: Mmmgh...

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>A normal boy dressed in a school uniform...
In fact, he might be a high school student, too.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Un chico normal con uniforme escolar...
De hecho, quizá también vaya a la preparatoria.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>He looked bewildered, and when he slowly
lifted his head...
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Se veía desconcertado, y cuando levantó
la cabeza lentamente...

c00_005_018.stx.en: ...Ahh! Aaugh!!!

How rude! Don't freak out at me like I'm some
sort of monster!
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡Qué grosero! ¡No te asustes de mí como si
fuera una especie de monstruo!

c00_005_018.stx.en: Ah, sorry...
c00_005_018.stx.es: Ah, perdón...

c00_005_018.stx.en:
I'm sorry too, okay?
I just have no idea what's going on...
c00_005_018.stx.es:
Yo también lo siento, ¿sí?
Es que no tengo idea de qué está pasando...

c00_005_018.stx.en:
But...all the more reason why we need to stay
calm. Oh! "Gymnopédie No. 1" by Erik Satie.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
Pero...por eso mismo hay que mantener la
calma. ¡Ah! "Gymnopédie No. 1" de Erik Satie.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Try to imagine that sorrowful melody filling
your head and soothing your heart—
c00_005_018.stx.es:
Imagina esa melodía melancólica llenándote
la cabeza y calmándote el corazón—

c00_005_018.stx.en: Rise and shine, ursine!
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¡Arriba, arriba, que llegó el oso!

c00_005_018.stx.en: Aaaaaahhh!!!
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¡¡¡Aaaaaahhh!!!

c00_005_018.stx.en: A teddy bear...?
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¿Un osito de peluche...?

c00_005_018.stx.en:
N-No, it's a monster! You can freak out
about this!
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡N-No, es un monstruo! ¡De esto sí te
puedes asustar!

c00_005_018.stx.en: Gahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¡Gahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

c00_005_018.stx.en: I don't think she was talking to you.
c00_005_018.stx.es: No creo que te lo dijera a ti.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
That's so mean... You humans are the
real monsters for calling us monsters!
c00_005_018.stx.es:
Qué crueles... ¡Ustedes los humanos son los
verdaderos monstruos por llamarnos monstruos!

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Although, if we are monsters, at least
we're pretty monsters.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
Aunque, si somos monstruos, al menos
somos monstruos bonitos.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
I agree. I'm glad I was born with these looks.
I definitely won the genetic lottery.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
De acuerdo. Me alegra haber nacido así de lindo.
Definitivamente me saqué la lotería genética.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Wh-What are they? Why are they talking?
Aren't they just...stuffed animals?
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¿Q-Qué son? ¿Por qué hablan?
¿No son solo...peluches?

c00_005_018.stx.en:
We're not Monokubs!
We're the stuffed animals!
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡No somos los Monokubs!
¡Somos los peluches!

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Psst, Monokid... You're saying your lines
backwards.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
Psst, Monokid... Estás diciendo tus líneas
al revés.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
No stuffed animals, us!
The Monokubs, them!
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡Peluches no, nosotros!
¡Los Monokubs, ellos!

c00_005_018.stx.en: Oh geez, it's even worse now...
c00_005_018.stx.es: Ay, cielos, ahora es todavía peor...

c00_005_018.stx.en: ...Huh? Monokubs?
c00_005_018.stx.es: ...¿Eh? ¿Monokubs?

c00_005_018.stx.en: Oh! You've heard of us!?
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¡Oh! ¡¿Ya habían oído de nosotros?!

c00_005_018.stx.en:
N-No, of course not!
I've never seen walking, talking stuffed animals!
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡N-No, claro que no!
¡Nunca había visto peluches que hablan!

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>As soon as I said that, these Monokub things
started looking at each other and...
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>En cuanto dije eso, esas cosas llamadas
Monokubs se miraron entre sí y...

c00_005_018.stx.en: Yayyyy! It worked!
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¡Yeeei! ¡Funcionó!

c00_005_018.stx.en: Phew! Had me worried there for a second!
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¡Uf! ¡Por un segundo me preocupé!

c00_005_018.stx.en:
H-Hey, worried about what?
I don't understand what's going on.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
O-Oigan, ¿preocuparse por qué?
No entiendo qué está pasando.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Alright now, let's tackle each issue one
at a time!
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡Muy bien, vamos a resolver los problemas
uno por uno!

c00_005_018.stx.en: You're so damn reliable, Monotaro!
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¡Eres bien confiable, Monotaro!

c00_005_018.stx.en:
He's like a sixth-grader helpin' out a
fifth-grader!
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡Es como un niño de sexto ayudando a
uno de quinto!

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Which means we should keep our
expectations reasonable.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
O sea que no hay que esperar
gran cosa.

c00_005_018.stx.en: Well? What's your question?
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¿Y bien? ¿Cuál es tu pregunta?

c00_005_018.stx.en: I have loads of questions, but for starters...
c00_005_018.stx.es: Tengo muchas preguntas, pero para empezar...

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Where are we?
This...looks like a school...
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¿Dónde estamos?
Esto...parece una escuela...

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Okay, so this place is called the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate
Academy for Gifted Juveniles<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
Bueno, este lugar se llama la <CLT=cltSTRONG>Academia
Definitiva para Jóvenes Superdotados<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_005_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Academy for Gifted Juveniles<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¿<CLT=cltSTRONG>Academia Definitiva para Jóvenes Superdotados<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Ultimate Academy?
I've never heard of a school like that...
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¿Academia Definitiva?
Nunca había oído de una escuela así...

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Of course you haven't. This school was
made for you sixteen cretins.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
Claro que no. Esta escuela se hizo para
ustedes dieciséis cretinos.

c00_005_018.stx.en: Sixteen...?
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¿Dieciséis...?

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Yeah! There are sixteen <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL> at this
school.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡Sí! En esta escuela hay dieciséis
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_005_018.stx.en: ...Huh? <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL>!?
c00_005_018.stx.es: ...¿Eh? ¡¿<CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL>?!

c00_005_018.stx.en: You know what <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL> are, right?
c00_005_018.stx.es: Sabes lo que son los <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL>, ¿no?

c00_005_018.stx.en:
The government scouts 'em through this
program called the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Initiative<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
El gobierno los recluta con un programa
llamado <CLT=cltSTRONG>Iniciativa Definitiva<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL>" basically means you're particularly
<CLT=cltSTRONG>prodigious<CLT=cltNORMAL> in a particular <CLT=cltSTRONG>talent<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>" quiere decir que eres un
<CLT=cltSTRONG>prodigio<CLT=cltNORMAL> en un <CLT=cltSTRONG>talento<CLT=cltNORMAL> en particular.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Basically, the Ultimate Initiative exists to
cultivate talent throughout the country...
c00_005_018.stx.es:
La Iniciativa Definitiva existe para cultivar
el talento en todo el país...

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Promising students are eligible to receive
all kinds of special handouts!
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡Los estudiantes prometedores pueden recibir
toda clase de beneficios especiales!

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Like free school tuition, voting privileges,
eligibility to run for elected office...
c00_005_018.stx.es:
Como colegiatura gratis, derecho al voto,
posibilidad de postularse a cargos públicos...

c00_005_018.stx.en: They even get grant money too, right?
c00_005_018.stx.es: Hasta reciben dinero de becas, ¿no?

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Students chosen by the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Initiative<CLT=cltNORMAL>
are known as <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
A los estudiantes elegidos por la <CLT=cltSTRONG>Iniciativa
Definitiva<CLT=cltNORMAL> se les conoce como <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Hell yeah! Students would do anything for
the honor of bein' a chosen <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡Hell yeah! ¡Los estudiantes harían lo que sea
por el honor de ser un <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL> elegido!

c00_005_018.stx.en:
I don't need the explanation, I already know.
Because...I'm an Ultimate, too.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
No necesito la explicación, ya lo sé.
Porque...yo también soy Definitiva.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
That means you gotta remember this time.
So don't forget anymore.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
O sea que esta vez lo tienes que recordar.
Así que ya no lo olvides.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Yeah! Forgetting about your <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL>
talent is such a waste.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡Sí! Olvidarse de su talento <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>
es un desperdicio.

c00_005_018.stx.en: Huh? What do you mean, "forgetting"?
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¿Eh? ¿Cómo que "olvidarse"?

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Shut up! Quit your yappin' and get started
already!
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡Cállate! ¡Deja de parlotear y empiecen
de una vez!

c00_005_018.stx.en: Get started...with what?
c00_005_018.stx.es: ¿Empezar...con qué?

c00_005_018.stx.en: Why, exploring this academy, of course.
c00_005_018.stx.es: Pues, a explorar la academia, por supuesto.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Also...you should introduce yourselves to
the other <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
Además...deberían presentarse con los
otros <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
...Cuz you guys are all gonna do an <CLT=cltSTRONG>activity<CLT=cltNORMAL>
together later.
c00_005_018.stx.es:
...Porque más tarde todos van a hacer
una <CLT=cltSTRONG>actividad<CLT=cltNORMAL> juntos.

c00_005_018.stx.en:
Awesome! I've got a rager right now!
Well then...
c00_005_018.stx.es:
¡Genial! ¡Ando súper prendido!
Bueno, entonces...

c00_005_018.stx.en:
...Ah, they left! But I still have so many
questions!
c00_005_018.stx.es:
...¡Ah, se fueron! ¡Pero todavía tengo
muchas preguntas!

c00_005_018.stx.en: This...isn't a dream, right?
c00_005_018.stx.es: Esto...no es un sueño, ¿verdad?

c00_005_018.stx.en: No, but I wish it was...
c00_005_018.stx.es: No, pero ojalá lo fuera...

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>A-Anyway...we have to find a way
out of here!
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>E-En fin...¡tenemos que encontrar
la forma de salir de aquí!

c00_005_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>But...they said there are sixteen
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltMIND> students here...
c00_005_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Pero...dijeron que aquí hay dieciséis
estudiantes <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltMIND>...

c00_005_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>Does that mean...he's one, too?
c00_005_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>¿Eso quiere decir...que él también es uno?

c00_006_018.stx.en: Um... Are you an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> student, too?
c00_006_018.stx.es: Oye... ¿Tú también eres un estudiante <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

c00_006_018.stx.en:
Y-Yeah...
Well, then...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
S-Sí...
Bueno, pues...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
I'm...Shuichi Saihara. They call me 
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>, but...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Soy...Shuichi Saihara. Me dicen 
el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Detective Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>, pero...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
What? You're a detective?
That's amazing!
c00_006_018.stx.es:
¿Qué? ¿Eres detective?
¡Qué increíble!

c00_006_018.stx.en:
Ah, no...I don't have the credentials
to call myself a detective yet.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Ah, no...todavía no tengo las credenciales
para llamarme detective.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
I just...happened to solve a case that
I came across and...now people call me that.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Solo...resolví por casualidad un caso con el
que me topé y...ahora me llaman así.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
Not many people can "just happen" to solve
a case. You should be more proud of that.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
No cualquiera resuelve un caso "por casualidad".
Deberías estar más orgulloso.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
Oh, yeah... My name is Kaede Akamatsu.
I'm the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltNORMAL>. Nice to meet you!
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Ah, cierto... Me llamo Kaede Akamatsu.
Soy la <CLT=cltSTRONG>Pianista Definitiva<CLT=cltNORMAL>. ¡Mucho gusto!

c00_006_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL>...Pianist...
c00_006_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltSTRONG>Pianista<CLT=cltNORMAL>...Definitiva...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
Well, no one calls me the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Usually just <CLT=cltSTRONG>Piano Freak<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Bueno, nadie me dice <CLT=cltSTRONG>Pianista Definitiva<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Normalmente me dicen <CLT=cltSTRONG>Loca del Piano<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
Ever since I was a child, I would play the
piano whenever I got bored...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Desde niña, tocaba el piano cada vez
que me aburría...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
There were even times I played the piano so
much, that I would forget to eat and sleep.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Hubo veces en que toqué tanto el piano
que se me olvidaba comer y dormir.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
Eventually, I won trophies from concerts.
And people started praising me...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Con el tiempo, gané trofeos en concursos.
Y la gente empezó a elogiarme...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
That's how you got your Ultimate title?
That's way more impressive than me...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
¿Así obtuviste tu título de Definitiva?
Eso es mucho más impresionante que lo mío...

c00_006_018.stx.en: No. That's all I'm good for, really.
c00_006_018.stx.es: No. En realidad es lo único que sé hacer.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
But this is my first time meeting another
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> student.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Pero es la primera vez que conozco a otro
estudiante <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
Well, <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL> are scattered all over
the country. They're difficult to find.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Bueno, los <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL> están repartidos por
todo el país. Es difícil encontrarlos.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
Even so, there are sixteen Ultimate students
gathered here now.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Aun así, ahora hay dieciséis estudiantes
Definitivos reunidos aquí.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
But why is everyone here?
Were we kidnapped?
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Pero ¿por qué estamos todos aquí?
¿Nos secuestraron?

c00_006_018.stx.en:
If so, then...is some organization out there
trying to kidnap all the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Si es así...¿hay alguna organización tratando
de secuestrar a todos los <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

c00_006_018.stx.en: Ah...about that...
c00_006_018.stx.es: Ah...sobre eso...

c00_006_018.stx.en: I...don't remember.
c00_006_018.stx.es: No...me acuerdo.

c00_006_018.stx.en: Huh? You don't remember?
c00_006_018.stx.es: ¿Eh? ¿No te acuerdas?

c00_006_018.stx.en:
I've been trying to remember it,
but I can't...no matter how hard I try.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
He estado tratando de recordarlo,
pero no puedo...por más que lo intento.

c00_006_018.stx.en: I have no idea how I got here...
c00_006_018.stx.es: No tengo idea de cómo llegué aquí...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
When I woke up, I was in that locker.
I...don't know how I got there...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Cuando desperté, estaba en ese casillero.
No...sé cómo terminé ahí...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
It's like...that memory just
fell out of my head—
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Es como si...ese recuerdo se me
hubiera borrado de la cabeza—

c00_006_018.stx.en: Same here!
c00_006_018.stx.es: ¡A mí me pasa lo mismo!

c00_006_018.stx.en: ...Huh?
I can't remember anything...
c00_006_018.stx.es: No recuerdo nada...

c00_006_018.stx.en: Even though I'm trying so hard to remember—
c00_006_018.stx.es: Aunque me esfuerzo tanto por recordar—

c00_006_018.stx.en: Ah, are you okay? What's wrong?
c00_006_018.stx.es: Ah, ¿estás bien? ¿Qué te pasa?

c00_006_018.stx.en:
Oh...I'm fine.
I just got a headache...that's all.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Ah...estoy bien.
Solo me dolió la cabeza...nada más.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
...It can't be coincidence that we *both*
don't remember. What happened to us...?
c00_006_018.stx.es:
...No puede ser coincidencia que los dos
no recordemos. ¿Qué nos pasó...?

c00_006_018.stx.en:
I-I'm sure it's nothing to worry about.
Probably not a big deal.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
S-Seguro que no hay de qué preocuparse.
Probablemente no es nada grave.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
We're confused. We just need to relax, is all.
Oh! Let's imagine Maurice Ravel's "Sonatine"...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Estamos confundidos. Solo hay que relajarnos.
¡Ah! Imaginemos la "Sonatina" de Maurice Ravel...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
Is that...music?
I-I...don't really know much about music...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
¿Eso es...música?
Y-Yo...no sé mucho de música...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
I see... That's unfortunate. When we get
outta here, I'll share it with you...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Ya veo... Qué lástima. Cuando salgamos
de aquí, te la voy a mostrar...

c00_006_018.stx.en: But first, let's look for a way out.
c00_006_018.stx.es: Pero primero, busquemos una salida.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
And if there are other <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> students here,
we should talk to them, too.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Y si hay otros estudiantes <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL> aquí,
también deberíamos hablar con ellos.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
At least one of them has got to know
something.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Al menos uno de ellos tiene que saber
algo.

c00_006_018.stx.en: ...Yeah, good idea.
c00_006_018.stx.es: ...Sí, buena idea.

c00_006_018.stx.es:

c00_006_018.stx.en:
What is going on...?
I hope...*someone* here knows...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
¿Qué está pasando...?
Ojalá...alguien aquí lo sepa...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
We'll be fine, so don't look so down.
Everything will make sense soon.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
Vamos a estar bien, así que no pongas esa cara.
Pronto todo va a tener sentido.

c00_006_018.stx.en: Y-Yeah...
c00_006_018.stx.es: S-Sí...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>The Monokubs said there were sixteen
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltMIND> students here...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Los Monokubs dijeron que aquí hay dieciséis
estudiantes <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltMIND>...

c00_006_018.stx.en:

I'll just ask him...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Me pregunto si él también es uno.
Se lo voy a preguntar...

<CLT=cltMIND>Me pregunto si él también es uno.

c00_006_018.stx.en: Yes
c00_006_018.stx.es: Sí

c00_006_018.stx.en: No
c00_006_018.stx.es: No

c00_006_018.stx.en: Are you unsure of something?
c00_006_018.stx.es: ¿Tienes alguna duda?

c00_006_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
c00_006_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>¿Quieres salir?

c00_006_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>That's a blackboard, right?
Every classroom has one, but...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Eso es un pizarrón, ¿no?
Todos los salones tienen uno, pero...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This blackboard is also an LCD screen.
That's something you don't see every day...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Este pizarrón también es una pantalla LCD.
Eso no se ve todos los días...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This blackboard is also an LCD screen.
That's something you don't see every day...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Este pizarrón también es una pantalla LCD.
Eso no se ve todos los días...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>The outside of the window is covered in
greenery, and... Is this barbed wire?
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Del otro lado de la ventana hay vegetación,
y... ¿Esto es alambre de púas?

c00_006_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Why are the school windows covered in
barbed wire?
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Por qué las ventanas de la escuela están
cubiertas de alambre de púas?

c00_006_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Why are the school windows covered in
barbed wire?
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Por qué las ventanas de la escuela están
cubiertas de alambre de púas?

<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltMIND> students here...
c00_006_018.stx.es:

estudiantes <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltMIND>...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder if he's one, too.
I'll just ask him...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Me pregunto si él también es uno.
Se lo voy a preguntar...

c00_006_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>We woke up inside of these lockers...
c00_006_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Despertamos dentro de estos casilleros...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>But why were we in these lockers
in the first place?
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Pero ¿por qué estábamos en estos casilleros
en primer lugar?

c00_006_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>We came out of these lockers...
c00_006_018.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Salimos de estos casilleros...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Why were we put inside lockers?
I don't understand...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Por qué nos metieron en casilleros?
No entiendo...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Is this a monitor?
Nothing's being displayed right now...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Esto es un monitor?
Ahora mismo no muestra nada...

c00_006_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Seriously though, what is it?
It really seems out of place here.
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>En serio, ¿qué es esto?
Se ve totalmente fuera de lugar aquí.

c00_006_018.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This monitor is way too high-tech to be
used in a school...
c00_006_018.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Este monitor es demasiado avanzado para
usarse en una escuela...
