c00_007_001.stx.en:
Oh, hey there.
You guys get kidnapped too?
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Ah, hola.
¿A ustedes también los secuestraron?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Well, you both look alright.
That's good.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Bueno, se ven bien.
Eso es bueno.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Situation could be better, though.
c00_007_001.stx.es: Aunque la situación podría estar mejor.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Yeah...totally.
c00_007_001.stx.es: Sí...totalmente.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Hey, let me ask you something...
c00_007_001.stx.es: Oigan, déjenme preguntarles algo...

c00_007_001.stx.en: Do you guys remember how you got here?
c00_007_001.stx.es: ¿Recuerdan cómo llegaron aquí?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
If you're asking us, then...you don't
remember either, do you?
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Si nos lo preguntas, entonces...tú tampoco
lo recuerdas, ¿verdad?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Ha, you're the same way too, huh?
You don't remember anything, do you?
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Ja, a ustedes les pasa lo mismo, ¿eh?
No recuerdan nada, ¿verdad?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
I guess that means everyone
here's the same.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Supongo que eso quiere decir que todos
aquí estamos igual.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Huh? Everyone?
c00_007_001.stx.es: ¿Eh? ¿Todos?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
I asked the others too.
They all said they don't remember.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
También les pregunté a los demás.
Todos dijeron que no recuerdan.

c00_007_001.stx.en: So the others don't remember, either...
c00_007_001.stx.es: Así que los demás tampoco recuerdan...

c00_007_001.stx.en: It's like...we all have amnesia or something.
c00_007_001.stx.es: Es como si...todos tuviéramos amnesia o algo así.

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Ah, but that's...not normal.
If everyone here has amnesia—
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Ah, pero eso...no es normal.
Si todos aquí tienen amnesia—

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Welp, I guess we're all in a
pretty abnormal situation then.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Bueno, supongo que estamos en una
situación bastante anormal.

c00_007_001.stx.en: ...What?

Wait...amnesia's a stretch. We're probably just
confused...I'm sure we'll remember eventually.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Espera...amnesia es exagerar. Seguro solo estamos
confundidos...Tarde o temprano recordaremos.

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Or it could be group hypnosis,
maybe brainwashing...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
O podría ser hipnosis colectiva,
o tal vez un lavado de cerebro...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
In any case...
I hope we remember soon.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
En cualquier caso...
ojalá recordemos pronto.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Otherwise...I'll end up the outcast.
c00_007_001.stx.es: Si no...voy a terminar siendo el raro.

c00_007_001.stx.en: The outcast...? What do you mean?
c00_007_001.stx.es: ¿El raro...? ¿A qué te refieres?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
To tell you the truth, how I got here
isn't the only thing I don't remember.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
La verdad, cómo llegué aquí no es lo
único que no recuerdo.

c00_007_001.stx.en: I also forgot...my own talent.
c00_007_001.stx.es: También olvidé...mi propio talento.

c00_007_001.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>What?
c00_007_001.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>¿Qué?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Phew, I'm in trouble. I know I must have been
some kind of <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Uf, estoy en problemas. Sé que debo ser
algún tipo de <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

c00_007_001.stx.en: I just don't remember.
c00_007_001.stx.es: Simplemente no lo recuerdo.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Is that true...?
c00_007_001.stx.es: ¿En serio...?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
'Course it is. But then again,
I don't blame you for not believing me.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Claro que sí. Aunque, la verdad,
no te culpo por no creerme.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Oh...I never told you my name, did I?
c00_007_001.stx.es: Ah...nunca les dije mi nombre, ¿verdad?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
It's not like...I already told you,
but then I forgot I did, right?
c00_007_001.stx.es:
No es que...ya se los haya dicho
y luego se me olvidó, ¿verdad?

c00_007_001.stx.en: No, you haven't told me your name yet.
c00_007_001.stx.es: No, todavía no nos dices tu nombre.

c00_007_001.stx.en: My name is Rantaro Amami.
c00_007_001.stx.es: Me llamo Rantaro Amami.

c00_007_001.stx.en:
I can't remember my <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> talent at the
moment...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Por ahora no recuerdo mi talento
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
But I promise, I'm not a bad guy.
Nice to meet ya.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Pero te prometo que no soy mala persona.
Mucho gusto.

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>For someone who can't remember his talent,
he doesn't seem too shaken up about it...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Para alguien que no recuerda su talento,
no parece muy preocupado...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
...Is it weird? That I'm not really bothered
by the fact that I don't remember my talent?
c00_007_001.stx.es:
...¿Es raro? ¿Que no me moleste mucho
no recordar mi talento?

c00_007_001.stx.en: What?
c00_007_001.stx.es: ¿Qué?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
You know, I'm actually kinda looking forward
to finding out. I wonder what <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> I am...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
¿Sabes? La verdad tengo ganas de descubrirlo.
Me pregunto qué clase de <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL> seré...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Anyway, it'd be nice if we could get along.
We aren't going anywhere for a while.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
En fin, estaría bien que nos lleváramos bien.
Vamos a estar aquí un buen rato.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Stop that. We'll escape soon.
c00_007_001.stx.es: No digas eso. Pronto vamos a escapar.

c00_007_001.stx.en: ...You really think it's gonna be that easy?
c00_007_001.stx.es: ...¿De verdad crees que va a ser tan fácil?

c00_007_001.stx.en: Huh? What do you mean...?
c00_007_001.stx.es: ¿Eh? ¿A qué te refieres...?

c00_007_001.stx.en: Nothin'. Just a feeling.
c00_007_001.stx.es: A nada. Solo es un presentimiento.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Haha, hey, don't worry about it, alright?
c00_007_001.stx.es: Jaja, oye, no te preocupes, ¿sí?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I thought he would be a pretty chill guy
to talk to, but...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Pensé que sería un chico bastante
tranquilo para platicar, pero...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>...I have no idea what's going through
his head right now.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>...no tengo idea de qué está pensando
en este momento.

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Rantaro's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been
updated based on your experience with him.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>El <CLT=cltSTRONG>Boletín<CLT=cltSYSTEM> de Rantaro se actualizó
con lo que viviste con él.

c00_007_001.stx.en:
But I would at least like to remember my
talent by the time we get out of here.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Pero al menos me gustaría recordar mi
talento para cuando salgamos de aquí.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Looks like we've got plenty of time—
c00_007_001.stx.es: Parece que tenemos tiempo de sobra—

c00_007_001.stx.en: Oops, sorry. Shouldn't jinx it.
c00_007_001.stx.es: Uy, perdón. Mejor no la salo.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Our way out of the entrance hall is barred.
c00_007_001.stx.es: La salida del vestíbulo está bloqueada.

c00_007_001.stx.en: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*
c00_007_001.stx.es: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>Clic...clic...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
If this bookcase can move, then I can get in,
but...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Si este librero se puede mover, podría entrar,
pero...

c00_007_001.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>Is this...the gym?
c00_007_001.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>¿Esto es...el gimnasio?

c00_007_001.stx.en: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*
c00_007_001.stx.es: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>Clic...clic...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Huh? It won't open.
Seems like we can't go into the gym.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
¿Eh? No abre.
Parece que no podemos entrar al gimnasio.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Hm? What's the matter, Shuichi?
c00_007_001.stx.es: ¿Hm? ¿Qué pasa, Shuichi?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Ah, it's nothing...
I just...feel strange...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Ah, no es nada...
Solo...me siento raro...

c00_007_001.stx.en: Strange? How so?
c00_007_001.stx.es: ¿Raro? ¿Cómo?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Like...deja vu?
I feel like I've been here before...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Como...¿un deja vu?
Siento que ya había estado aquí...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
We might be...caught up in something
even stranger than we imagined.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Puede que...estemos metidos en algo
todavía más raro de lo que imaginamos.

c00_007_001.stx.en:
W-Well, it's natural to feel unsettled when
we know so little about what's going on...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
B-Bueno, es normal sentirse inquieto cuando
sabemos tan poco de lo que está pasando...

c00_007_001.stx.en: But we'll probably be fine.
c00_007_001.stx.es: Pero seguro que vamos a estar bien.

c00_007_001.stx.en: ...What makes you say that?
c00_007_001.stx.es: ...¿Por qué lo dices?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Because we have sixteen <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> students
on our side!
c00_007_001.stx.es:
¡Porque tenemos a dieciséis estudiantes
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL> de nuestro lado!

c00_007_001.stx.en:
As long as we work together as friends,
I just know nothing bad will happen!
c00_007_001.stx.es:
¡Mientras trabajemos juntos como amigos,
sé que no va a pasar nada malo!

c00_007_001.stx.en: Friends...?
c00_007_001.stx.es: ¿Amigos...?

c00_007_001.stx.en: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*
c00_007_001.stx.es: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>Clic...clic...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
I knew it... It won't open.
Seems like we can't get into the gym.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Lo sabía... No abre.
Parece que no podemos entrar al gimnasio.

c00_007_001.stx.en: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*
c00_007_001.stx.es: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>Clic...clic...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
I guess this doesn't open...
Let's look somewhere else...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Supongo que esto no abre...
Busquemos en otro lado...

c00_007_001.stx.en: Okay...
c00_007_001.stx.es: Está bien...

c00_007_001.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>This is the boys bathroom, right?
c00_007_001.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Este es el baño de hombres, ¿no?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I-I can't go in there!
Not even in this situation!
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¡N-No puedo entrar ahí!
¡Ni siquiera en esta situación!

c00_007_001.stx.en: Ah, if you want...I could go look?
c00_007_001.stx.es: Ah, si quieres...¿yo podría ir a ver?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
What!? I-I'm not *that* curious about what's
in there...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
¡¿Qué?! ¡N-No tengo tanta curiosidad por
lo que hay ahí dentro!

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Well, this is an unusual building...
Anything could be in there.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Bueno, este edificio es raro...
Ahí dentro podría haber cualquier cosa.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Wait here a minute.
c00_007_001.stx.es: Espera aquí un momento.

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>With that, Shuichi opened the door and
walked inside—
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Dicho eso, Shuichi abrió la puerta
y entró—

c00_007_001.stx.en:
It was just a normal bathroom, nothing
out of the ordinary. No one was inside.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Solo era un baño normal, nada fuera de
lo común. No había nadie adentro.

c00_007_001.stx.en: I-I see...
c00_007_001.stx.es: Y-Ya veo...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>That scared me... Maybe detectives live
for these kinda scary situations?
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Qué susto... ¿Será que a los detectives
les encantan estas situaciones de miedo?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I keep staring at the boys bathroom...
Stop it, Kaede. You know that's bad.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>No dejo de mirar el baño de hombres...
Ya basta, Kaede. Sabes que eso está mal.

c00_007_001.stx.en: Research Lab B
c00_007_001.stx.es: Laboratorio de investigación B

c00_007_001.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>This is the girls bathroom, right?
c00_007_001.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Este es el baño de mujeres, ¿no?

c00_007_001.stx.en: Shuichi, do you mind waiting here?
c00_007_001.stx.es: Shuichi, ¿te importa esperar aquí?

c00_007_001.stx.en: Ah, um, sure...
c00_007_001.stx.es: Ah, eh, claro...

c00_007_001.stx.en: D-Don't give me that weird look!
c00_007_001.stx.es: ¡N-No me mires así de raro!

c00_007_001.stx.en:
I'm just gonna check if there's anything inside!
I doubt there'd be an exit, but just in case...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
¡Solo voy a revisar si hay algo adentro!
Dudo que haya una salida, pero por si acaso...

c00_007_001.stx.en: S-Sorry...
c00_007_001.stx.es: P-Perdón...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Well, I don't need to use the bathroom
right now...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Bueno, ahorita no necesito usar
el baño...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>There are stairs here.
It looks like it goes down to the basement.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Aquí hay escaleras.
Parece que bajan al sótano.

c00_007_001.stx.en:
What should we do, Shuichi?
You wanna head down?
c00_007_001.stx.es:
¿Qué hacemos, Shuichi?
¿Quieres bajar?

c00_007_001.stx.en:
I-I dunno... The basement might be
dangerous. This place is full of mysteries.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
N-No sé... El sótano podría ser
peligroso. Este lugar está lleno de misterios.

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Then let's proceed with caution!
With you at the front!
c00_007_001.stx.es:
¡Entonces avancemos con cuidado!
¡Contigo adelante!

c00_007_001.stx.en:
Ah...so I'm in front.
I see...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
Ah...así que voy adelante.
Ya veo...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>With hesitant Shuichi leading the way, we
carefully made our way down the stairs.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Con un Shuichi indeciso al frente,
bajamos las escaleras con cuidado.

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Oh! We couldn't go through here before, right!?
Looks like the iron grate opened...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¡Ah! Antes no podíamos pasar por aquí, ¿no?
Parece que la reja de hierro se abrió...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Did someone open it for us?
Let's check it out.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Alguien la abrió por nosotros?
Vamos a ver.

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Oh! We couldn't go through here before, right!?
Looks like the iron grate opened...
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¡Ah! Antes no podíamos pasar por aquí, ¿no?
Parece que la reja de hierro se abrió...

c00_007_001.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Did someone open it for us?
Let's check it out.
c00_007_001.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Alguien la abrió por nosotros?
Vamos a ver.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Even though it's a hallway, there sure are
a lot of plants growing around here...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Aunque es un pasillo, hay muchísimas
plantas creciendo por aquí...

c00_007_002.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>And the air here is heavy...
c00_007_002.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Y el aire aquí se siente pesado...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Oppressively heavy, as if forcing you
to recall your fears, smothering you in anxiety...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Opresivamente pesado, como si te obligara a
recordar tus miedos y te ahogara en ansiedad...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>But this is just a school...right?
What kind of school makes you feel like this?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Pero esto solo es una escuela...¿verdad?
¿Qué clase de escuela te hace sentir así?

c00_007_002.stx.en: ...Huh?
What's the matter?
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¿Qué pasa?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Ah, I just...felt something in the pocket
of my uniform. When I looked...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Ah, es que...sentí algo en el bolsillo
de mi uniforme. Cuando me fijé...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
I found this inside.
It's some kind of...mini tablet computer?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Encontré esto adentro.
¿Es una especie de...mini tableta?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Oh, maybe I have one too!
I knew my backpack felt heavier!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¡Ah, tal vez yo también tengo una!
¡Ya decía que mi mochila pesaba más!

c00_007_002.stx.en: The word "Monopad" is written on it...
c00_007_002.stx.es: Tiene escrita la palabra "Monopad"...

c00_007_002.stx.en: When did this get in my backpack?
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¿Cuándo llegó esto a mi mochila?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
My name was displayed when it booted up.
Like a student handbook.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Al encenderse apareció mi nombre.
Como un manual del estudiante.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
I...don't know what it could be used for,
but I don't think we should throw it away.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
No...sé para qué podría servir,
pero no creo que debamos tirarlo.

c00_007_002.stx.en: Let's just...hold on to them for now.
c00_007_002.stx.es: Mejor...quedémonos con ellos por ahora.

c00_007_002.stx.en: Yeah, I agree.
c00_007_002.stx.es: Sí, estoy de acuerdo.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Congratulations!
You can now use the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Monopad<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>¡Felicidades!
¡Ya puedes usar el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Monopad<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Press the <PAD=【□】> button to open the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Monopad<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.
It's got tons of game information in it.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Presiona el botón <PAD=【□】> para abrir el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Monopad<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.
Tiene un montón de información del juego.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Stuff like the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> and <CLT=cltSTRONG>Map<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.
Be sure to check it out!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Cosas como el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Boletín<CLT=cltSYSTEM> y el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Mapa<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.
¡No dejes de revisarlo!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>And if you've got a sharp eye,
you may have already noticed...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Y si eres observador,
quizá ya lo notaste...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>By getting closer to your fellow students,
your <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> will be updated with content.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Al acercarte a tus compañeros, se agrega
contenido a tu <CLT=cltSTRONG>Boletín<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Since you are now acquaintances with 
Mr. Saihara, his info has already been added.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Como ya conoces al 
joven Saihara, ya se agregó su información.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>And I bet you've also already noticed you
can <CLT=cltSTRONG>level up<CLT=cltSYSTEM> by performing actions.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Y seguro también notaste que puedes
<CLT=cltSTRONG>subir de nivel<CLT=cltSYSTEM> al realizar acciones.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When you level up, your <CLT=cltSTRONG>skill slots<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
increase, so you can equip even more skills.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Al subir de nivel, aumentan tus <CLT=cltSTRONG>ranuras de
habilidad<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, para equipar más habilidades.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>There are a lot of skills, so view them
in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Hay muchas habilidades, ¡así que revísalas
en el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Boletín<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If you want skills, make friends!
Strengthen your bonds!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Si quieres habilidades, ¡haz amigos!
¡Fortalece tus lazos!

c00_007_002.stx.en: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>Be sure to test out all the skills!
c00_007_002.stx.es: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>¡No dejes de probar todas las habilidades!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Also...there's one more important
thing to tell you.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Además...hay otra cosa importante
que decirte.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can <CLT=cltSTRONG>save<CLT=cltSYSTEM> and <CLT=cltSTRONG>load<CLT=cltSYSTEM> the game
from the handbook.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Puedes <CLT=cltSTRONG>guardar<CLT=cltSYSTEM> y <CLT=cltSTRONG>cargar<CLT=cltSYSTEM> la partida
desde el manual.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Make sure you save all
the important stuff.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Asegúrate de guardar todo
lo importante.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Well then! Off you go!
Find your classmates!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>¡Bueno, entonces! ¡En marcha!
¡Encuentra a tus compañeros!

c00_007_002.stx.en: Umm...
c00_007_002.stx.es: Mmm...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Hey, you're an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> student, right?
Can we talk—
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Oye, eres una estudiante <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitiva<CLT=cltNORMAL>, ¿verdad?
¿Podemos hablar—

c00_007_002.stx.en: Ummmm...
c00_007_002.stx.es: Mmmmm...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Hm? Did she not hear me?
Okay, then...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Hm? ¿No me escuchó?
Bueno, entonces...

c00_007_002.stx.en: Heeey! Hellooooo!
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¡Hoooola! ¡Holaaaaa!

c00_007_002.stx.en: Ummmmmm...
c00_007_002.stx.es: Mmmmmmmm...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
What? She still can't hear me?
Maybe she's a really detailed mannequin?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¿Qué? ¿Sigue sin escucharme?
¿Será un maniquí muy detallado?

c00_007_002.stx.en: ...No, I don't think that's the case...
c00_007_002.stx.es: ...No, no creo que sea eso...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
You never know.
We already saw a moving teddy bear.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Nunca se sabe.
Ya vimos un osito de peluche que se mueve.

c00_007_002.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>As I said that, I poked her cheek...
c00_007_002.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Mientras decía eso, le piqué la mejilla...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>...and felt her skin squish beneath
my fingertip.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>...y sentí cómo su piel se hundía
bajo la punta de mi dedo.

c00_007_002.stx.en: Umm...
c00_007_002.stx.es: Mmm...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Poking her doesn't work either?
Then...maybe she is just a doll.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¿Tampoco funciona picarla?
Entonces...tal vez sí sea una muñeca.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
But she looks so real!
Try it, Shuichi! Poke, poke!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¡Pero se ve tan real!
¡Inténtalo, Shuichi! ¡Pica, pica!

c00_007_002.stx.en: Ah, no thanks...
c00_007_002.stx.es: Ah, no, gracias...

c00_007_002.stx.en: Just do it! It's so fun!
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¡Hazlo! ¡Es muy divertido!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>As I grabbed his hand to make him poke
her other cheek...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Mientras le agarraba la mano para que
le picara la otra mejilla...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
I never thought I'd be poked from 
both sides. How truly unexpected.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Nunca pensé que me picarían de 
ambos lados. Qué inesperado.

c00_007_002.stx.en: Ah!
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¡Ah!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
So she wasn't a mannequin.
Well, I knew that.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Así que no era un maniquí.
Bueno, eso ya lo sabía.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
If you knew that, why did
you make me poke her?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Si ya lo sabías, ¿por qué
me hiciste picarla?

c00_007_002.stx.en: Because she wasn't responding.
c00_007_002.stx.es: Porque no respondía.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Oh, I didn't mean any harm... 
I was just deep in thought.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Ah, no lo hice con mala intención... 
Solo estaba muy concentrada pensando.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
So I thought if I ignored you, 
you'd go somewhere else.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Así que pensé que si los ignoraba, 
se irían a otro lado.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
You were ignoring us?
Isn't that a bit rude?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¿Nos estabas ignorando?
¿No es un poco grosero?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Umm, well isn't it rude to force someone 
to talk when they don't want to?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Mmm, bueno, ¿no es grosero obligar a alguien 
a hablar cuando no quiere?

c00_007_002.stx.en: Oh, but it's fine. I feel like talking now.
c00_007_002.stx.es: Ah, pero no importa. Ahora sí quiero hablar.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Now, let's talk. What do you want 
to start with?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Bueno, hablemos. ¿Por dónde 
quieren empezar?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
My favorite Doraemon episode is #53. The one
with security cameras and target practice.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Mi episodio favorito de Doraemon es el 53. El de
las cámaras de seguridad y el tiro al blanco.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Um, before you talk about that...
Can you tell us your name?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Eh, antes de que hables de eso...
¿Nos dices tu nombre?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Oh, my name is Tsumugi Shirogane.
I'm the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Cosplayer<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Ah, me llamo Tsumugi Shirogane.
Soy la <CLT=cltSTRONG>Cosplayer Definitiva<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_007_002.stx.en: So you're...a cosplayer.
c00_007_002.stx.es: Así que eres...cosplayer.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Are you...surprised? I get that a lot,
since I'm so plain.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¿Te...sorprende? Me lo dicen mucho,
porque soy simplemente sosa.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
I mean, it sorta makes sense. You have this
strange, almost sexy aura about you.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Bueno, tiene algo de sentido. Tienes un aura
rara, casi sexy.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
I bet it's because you've got people ogling
all your curves on a daily basis, huh?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Seguro es porque todos los días la gente
te come con los ojos, ¿eh?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Kaede...you sound like a creepy
old man...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Kaede...hablas como un viejo
rabo verde...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Normally, I don't really like people looking
at me like that...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Normalmente no me gusta mucho que la gente
me mire así...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
I just like making cosplay. 
I'm fine with others wearing them...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Solo me gusta hacer cosplay. 
No me molesta que otros los usen...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
But lately, more cosplayers are putting 
themselves before their characters.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Pero últimamente, más cosplayers se ponen 
a sí mismos antes que a sus personajes.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
I'd rather wear my outfits myself, with love, 
than give them to people like that.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Prefiero usar mis trajes yo misma, con amor, 
que dárselos a gente así.

c00_007_002.stx.en: Wow...you're pretty intense.
c00_007_002.stx.es: Vaya...eres muy intensa.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
It makes me happy when I get to show 
people the outfits I've made.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Me hace feliz poder mostrarle a la gente 
los trajes que hago.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
And thanks to my sponsors, I can use
materials that are just plain expensive.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Y gracias a mis patrocinadores, puedo usar
materiales que son simplemente carísimos.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Ohhh! Well, of course the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Cosplayer<CLT=cltNORMAL>
would have sponsors!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¡Ohhh! ¡Claro que la <CLT=cltSTRONG>Cosplayer Definitiva<CLT=cltNORMAL>
tendría patrocinadores!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
It's not a big deal. People just crowd around
like I'm a panda at the zoo.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
No es para tanto. La gente solo se amontona
como si fuera un panda en el zoológico.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
That's so amazing...
You're pretty much a celebrity, you know?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Qué increíble...
Prácticamente eres una celebridad, ¿sabes?

c00_007_002.stx.en: Ah, is it alright if I ask you something too?
c00_007_002.stx.es: Ah, ¿puedo preguntarte algo también?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Earlier...you looked as if you were thinking
hard about something. What was it?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Hace rato...parecías estar pensando mucho
en algo. ¿Qué era?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Oh, yeah! We needed to ask her that!
Nice job, Shuichi!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¡Ah, sí! ¡Teníamos que preguntarle eso!
¡Bien hecho, Shuichi!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Ah...that <CLT=cltSTRONG>bronze dragon statue<CLT=cltNORMAL> over 
there. I'm just plain curious about it.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Ah...esa <CLT=cltSTRONG>estatua de dragón de bronce<CLT=cltNORMAL> de 
allá. Simplemente me da curiosidad.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
It almost seems like it's floating, right? 
Doesn't it look pretty out of place?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Casi parece que está flotando, ¿no? 
¿No se ve bastante fuera de lugar?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Now that you mention it...you're right.
It sorta bothers me, too.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Ahora que lo mencionas...tienes razón.
A mí también me molesta un poco.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
This is a school, right? But everything here
is so weird, isn't it?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Esto es una escuela, ¿no? Pero todo aquí
es muy raro, ¿verdad?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
There's trees and grass growing inside,
I can't find any exits...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Hay árboles y pasto creciendo adentro,
no encuentro ninguna salida...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
And it seems like we're the only
people here...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Y parece que somos las únicas
personas aquí...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Are we...going to be okay? Are we going
to be able to get out?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¿Vamos...a estar bien? ¿Vamos a
poder salir?

c00_007_002.stx.en: Kaede? What's wrong?
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¿Kaede? ¿Qué pasa?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Hehe, that frightened look on her face was
sorta sexy.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Jeje, esa cara de susto que puso
se veía medio sexy.

c00_007_002.stx.en: ...This again?
c00_007_002.stx.es: ...¿Otra vez con eso?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
I'm just kidding...
Well, it's not a big deal.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Solo bromeo...
Bueno, no es para tanto.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Our present situation is our main concern.
Once it's over, we'll be good and dandy.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Lo que importa es la situación actual.
Cuando termine, todo va a estar de maravilla.

c00_007_002.stx.en: You're...pretty optimistic, Kaede.
c00_007_002.stx.es: Eres...bastante optimista, Kaede.

c00_007_002.stx.en: Well, people do say I'm carefree!
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¡Bueno, la gente dice que soy despreocupada!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Worrying won't get you anywhere, you know.
It's better to just be carefree.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Preocuparse no sirve de nada, ¿sabes?
Es mejor ser despreocupada.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Yeah...I guess so. Being all depressed 
won't help anything.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Sí...supongo. Estar deprimida 
no ayuda en nada.

c00_007_002.stx.en: Yeah. So, let's try to find a way out.
c00_007_002.stx.es: Sí. Así que tratemos de encontrar una salida.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Tsumugi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been
updated based on your experience with her.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>El <CLT=cltSTRONG>Boletín<CLT=cltSYSTEM> de Tsumugi se actualizó
con lo que viviste con ella.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Yeah, being depressed won't help
anything...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Sí, estar deprimida no ayuda
en nada...

c00_007_002.stx.en: It's plain to see the next con is coming up!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¡Es simplemente obvio que ya viene la
próxima convención!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
*sigh*...That's right. What am I gonna do
if I don't finish my outfit in time?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Ay... Así es. ¿Qué voy a hacer si no
termino mi traje a tiempo?

c00_007_002.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltMIND>'s research lab, huh?
c00_007_002.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>El laboratorio de la <CLT=cltSTRONG>Pianista Definitiva<CLT=cltMIND>, ¿eh?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Oh well. I can play as much piano as I want
when I finally escape this place.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Bueno. Podré tocar el piano todo lo que
quiera cuando por fin escape de aquí.

c00_007_002.stx.en: Kirumi Tojo's Research Lab
c00_007_002.stx.es: Laboratorio de Kirumi Tojo

c00_007_002.stx.en: Gonta Gokuhara's Research Lab
c00_007_002.stx.es: Laboratorio de Gonta Gokuhara

c00_007_002.stx.en: 3rd Floor
c00_007_002.stx.es: Piso 3

c00_007_002.stx.en: What is this...?
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¿Qué es esto...?

c00_007_002.stx.en: It looks like...a dragon statue.
c00_007_002.stx.es: Parece...una estatua de dragón.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
But why is there a dragon statue in the
school's hallway?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Pero ¿por qué hay una estatua de dragón
en el pasillo de la escuela?

c00_007_002.stx.en: I-I have no idea...
c00_007_002.stx.es: N-No tengo idea...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Hmm... Maybe it's part of the school's
official art collection or something?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Mmm... ¿Tal vez es parte de la colección
de arte oficial de la escuela?

c00_007_002.stx.en: Still, no idea...
c00_007_002.stx.es: Sigo sin tener idea...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This statue looks really out of place...
What's it even doing here?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Esta estatua se ve muy fuera de lugar...
¿Qué hace aquí?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Oh! Wait a minute!
Is this the music room?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¡Ah! ¡Espera un momento!
¿Este es el salón de música?

c00_007_002.stx.en: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click*
c00_007_002.stx.es: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>Clic

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Huh... It won't open. But this room does look
like it was made for me...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Eh... No abre. Pero este cuarto sí parece
hecho para mí...

c00_007_002.stx.en: Rise and shine, ursine!
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¡Arriba, arriba, que llegó el oso!

c00_007_002.stx.en: Ah! They're here again!
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¡Ah! ¡Otra vez ellos!

c00_007_002.stx.en: Whaddaya think this place is?
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¿Qué creen que es este lugar?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Check out all this fancy-shmancy writing!
Seems like a place for eggheads!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¡Miren todo este letrero tan elegantoso!
¡Parece un lugar para cerebritos!

c00_007_002.stx.en: Huh? Isn't this an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Research Lab<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¿Eh? ¿No es un <CLT=cltSTRONG>Laboratorio Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
What the hell? Why would you tell them?
We were tryin' to make it all dramatic.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¿Qué demonios? ¿Por qué se los dices?
Queríamos hacerlo todo dramático.

c00_007_002.stx.en: Oh, I see... I'm sorry.
c00_007_002.stx.es: Ah, ya veo... Lo siento.

c00_007_002.stx.en: Huh? What's an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Research Lab<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¿Eh? ¿Qué es un <CLT=cltSTRONG>Laboratorio Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
We want you guys to keep honing your <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL>
talents, so we set up these rooms for you.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Queremos que sigan puliendo sus talentos
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivos<CLT=cltNORMAL>, así que les preparamos estos cuartos.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
This is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s lab, but we set up
labs for the other Ultimates too, of course.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Este es el laboratorio de la <CLT=cltSTRONG>Pianista Definitiva<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
pero claro, también hay para los demás.

c00_007_002.stx.en: Most of 'em are still hidden, though!
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¡Aunque la mayoría todavía están escondidos!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
By the way...the reason this research lab
is still locked is...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Por cierto...la razón por la que este
laboratorio sigue cerrado es...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Cuz we're still setting up everything...
Sorry, we'll hustle to get it all ready.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Porque todavía lo estamos preparando...
Perdón, nos vamos a apurar para tenerlo listo.

c00_007_002.stx.en: Just wipe your asses and wait!
c00_007_002.stx.es: ¡Límpiense el trasero y esperen!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
That's good advice and all, but...don't you mean
to say, "hold your horses"?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
Es un buen consejo y todo, pero...¿no querías
decir "esperen sentados"?

c00_007_002.stx.en: Puhuhu... Monokid is such a dummy.
c00_007_002.stx.es: Pupupu... Monokid es un tontito.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
What are you laughin' at!? I'll bully you
like I bully Monodam!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¡¿De qué te ríes?! ¡Te voy a molestar
como molesto a Monodam!

c00_007_002.stx.en: It seems like the music room...
c00_007_002.stx.es: Parece el salón de música...

c00_007_002.stx.en: ...but I guess it's an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> lab.
c00_007_002.stx.es: ...pero supongo que es un laboratorio <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
Do you think...there really are
other rooms like this? For everyone?
c00_007_002.stx.es:
¿Crees que...de verdad hay otros
cuartos así? ¿Para todos?

c00_007_002.stx.en: I wonder about that too...
c00_007_002.stx.es: Yo también me lo pregunto...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Anyway...I thought this was the music room.
Aw, I really wanted to play the piano...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>En fin...pensé que era el salón de música.
Ay, de verdad quería tocar el piano...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Oh well. I can play as much piano as I want
when I finally escape this place.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Bueno. Podré tocar el piano todo lo que
quiera cuando por fin escape de aquí.

c00_007_002.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltMIND>'s research lab, huh?
c00_007_002.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>El laboratorio de la <CLT=cltSTRONG>Pianista Definitiva<CLT=cltMIND>, ¿eh?

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Oh well. I can play as much piano as I want
when I finally escape this place.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Bueno. Podré tocar el piano todo lo que
quiera cuando por fin escape de aquí.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
It won't open.
Let's look somewhere else.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
No abre.
Busquemos en otro lado.

c00_007_002.stx.en: Okay...
c00_007_002.stx.es: Está bien...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Congratulations!
You can now use the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Monopad<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>¡Felicidades!
¡Ya puedes usar el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Monopad<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Press the F key to open the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Monopad<CLT=cltSYSTEM>. 
It's got tons of game information in it.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Presiona la tecla F para abrir el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Monopad<CLT=cltSYSTEM>. 
Tiene un montón de información del juego.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Stuff like the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> and <CLT=cltSTRONG>Map<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.
Be sure to check it out!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Cosas como el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Boletín<CLT=cltSYSTEM> y el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Mapa<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.
¡No dejes de revisarlo!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>And if you've got a sharp eye,
you may have already noticed...
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Y si eres observador,
quizá ya lo notaste...

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>By getting closer to your fellow students,
your <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> will be updated with content.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Al acercarte a tus compañeros, se agrega
contenido a tu <CLT=cltSTRONG>Boletín<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Since you are now acquaintances with Mr. Saihara,
his information has already been added.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Como ya conoces al joven Saihara,
ya se agregó su información.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>And I bet you've also already noticed you
can <CLT=cltSTRONG>level up<CLT=cltSYSTEM> by performing actions.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Y seguro también notaste que puedes
<CLT=cltSTRONG>subir de nivel<CLT=cltSYSTEM> al realizar acciones.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When you level up, your <CLT=cltSTRONG>skill slots<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
increase, so you can equip even more skills.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Al subir de nivel, aumentan tus <CLT=cltSTRONG>ranuras de
habilidad<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, para equipar más habilidades.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>There are a lot of skills, so view them
in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Hay muchas habilidades, ¡así que revísalas
en el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Boletín<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If you want skills, make friends!
Strengthen your bonds!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Si quieres habilidades, ¡haz amigos!
¡Fortalece tus lazos!

c00_007_002.stx.en: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>Be sure to test out all the skills!
c00_007_002.stx.es: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>¡No dejes de probar todas las habilidades!

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Also...there's one more important
thing to tell you.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Además...hay otra cosa importante
que decirte.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can <CLT=cltSTRONG>save<CLT=cltSYSTEM> and <CLT=cltSTRONG>load<CLT=cltSYSTEM> the game
from the handbook.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Puedes <CLT=cltSTRONG>guardar<CLT=cltSYSTEM> y <CLT=cltSTRONG>cargar<CLT=cltSYSTEM> la partida
desde el manual.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Make sure you save all
the important stuff.
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Asegúrate de guardar todo
lo importante.

c00_007_002.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Well then! Off you go!
Find your classmates!
c00_007_002.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>¡Bueno, entonces! ¡En marcha!
¡Encuentra a tus compañeros!

c00_007_004.stx.en: It doesn't *look* very dangerous to me.
c00_007_004.stx.es: A mí no me parece muy peligroso.

c00_007_004.stx.en:
Ah, well...some dangers are hidden
where you can't see.
c00_007_004.stx.es:
Ah, bueno...algunos peligros están escondidos
donde no los puedes ver.

c00_007_004.stx.en:
Shuichi...you have quite the imagination,
don't you?

No, I just think you're not considering
how dangerous this is...
c00_007_004.stx.es:
No, es que creo que no estás considerando
lo peligroso que es esto...

c00_007_004.stx.en:
Yeah, maybe.
But we should look around the basement, too.
c00_007_004.stx.es:
Sí, tal vez.
Pero también deberíamos revisar el sótano.

c00_007_004.stx.en:
There might be an exit.
Oh, but we should be careful.
c00_007_004.stx.es:
Podría haber una salida.
Ah, pero hay que tener cuidado.

c00_007_004.stx.en:
This door barely opens a crack.
Was it poorly built?
c00_007_004.stx.es:
Esta puerta apenas se abre un poquito.
¿La habrán construido mal?

c00_007_004.stx.en:
Well, nothing we can do about it.
Let's search somewhere else.
c00_007_004.stx.es:
Bueno, no podemos hacer nada.
Busquemos en otro lado.

c00_007_004.stx.en:
This door barely opens a crack.
Was it poorly built?
c00_007_004.stx.es:
Esta puerta apenas se abre un poquito.
¿La habrán construido mal?

c00_007_004.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This monitor is way too high-tech to be
used in a school...
c00_007_004.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Este monitor es demasiado avanzado para
usarse en una escuela...

c00_007_004.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This monitor is way too high-tech to be
used in a school...
c00_007_004.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Este monitor es demasiado avanzado para
usarse en una escuela...

c00_007_010.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>Is this...a dining hall?
c00_007_010.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>¿Esto es...un comedor?

c00_007_010.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>A dining hall definitely makes this place
feel more like a school...
c00_007_010.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Un comedor definitivamente hace que este
lugar se sienta más como una escuela...

c00_007_010.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>But this place is called the Ultimate
Academy for Gifted Juveniles...
c00_007_010.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Pero este lugar se llama Academia Definitiva
para Jóvenes Superdotados...

c00_007_010.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>I doubt it's anything like a typical school.
c00_007_010.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Dudo que se parezca a una escuela normal.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
It seems this place has all the facilities
you'd expect but...it's covered in overgrowth.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Parece que este lugar tiene todas las instalaciones
que esperarías, pero...está cubierto de maleza.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Could that mean...this has been
abandoned for a long time?
c00_007_010.stx.es:
¿Será que...lleva mucho tiempo
abandonado?

c00_007_010.stx.en: Nyeeeh... So are we stuck here?
c00_007_010.stx.es: Nyeeeh... ¿Entonces estamos atrapados aquí?

c00_007_010.stx.en: Yeah...that's what it looks like...
c00_007_010.stx.es: Sí...eso parece...

c00_007_010.stx.en:
But don't be scared, I'm sure we'll be out
of this place in a jiffy!
c00_007_010.stx.es:
¡Pero no tengas miedo, seguro que saldremos
de aquí en un abrir y cerrar de ojos!

c00_007_010.stx.en:
I'm...not scared.
It's just a pain.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
No...tengo miedo.
Solo es una lata.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Something like this won't make me panic.
Cuz...I'm a mage.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Algo así no me va a hacer entrar en pánico.
Porque...soy una maga.

c00_007_010.stx.en: A mage?
c00_007_010.stx.es: ¿Una maga?

c00_007_010.stx.en: Hm...that's right. I haven't told you guys yet.
c00_007_010.stx.es: Hm...es cierto. Todavía no se los he dicho.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Prepare to be amazed. Fall to your knees.
I am Himiko Yumeno, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Mage<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Prepárense para asombrarse. Arrodíllense.
Soy Himiko Yumeno, la <CLT=cltSTRONG>Maga Definitiva<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
But...I'm officially called 
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Magician<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Pero...oficialmente me llaman 
la <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ilusionista Definitiva<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Ohh, so you're a magician.
You should've said that from the start.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Ahh, así que eres ilusionista.
Lo hubieras dicho desde el principio.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
I mean, it makes sense though.
Since magic doesn't exist.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
O sea, tiene sentido.
Como la magia no existe.

c00_007_010.stx.en: Nyeeeh...magic does exist.
c00_007_010.stx.es: Nyeeeh...la magia sí existe.

c00_007_010.stx.en: Huh?
c00_007_010.stx.es: ¿Eh?

c00_007_010.stx.en: Because...I am a mage.
c00_007_010.stx.es: Porque...yo soy una maga.

c00_007_010.stx.en: You're just a magician, right?
c00_007_010.stx.es: Solo eres ilusionista, ¿no?

c00_007_010.stx.en: Only on paper...
c00_007_010.stx.es: Solo en el papel...

c00_007_010.stx.en:
I'm known as a magician, but that's just a ruse.
I am actually...a mage.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Me conocen como ilusionista, pero es un engaño.
En realidad soy...una maga.

c00_007_010.stx.en: J-Just a ruse...?
c00_007_010.stx.es: ¿S-Solo un engaño...?

c00_007_010.stx.en:
You guys might not know them, but...
There's a group called the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Magic Castle<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Quizá no lo conozcan, pero...
hay un grupo llamado el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Castillo Mágico<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Also known as the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Hall of Magicians<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
it's where the world's magic lovers gather.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
También conocido como el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Salón de los Magos<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
ahí se reúnen los amantes de la magia del mundo.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
I was the youngest person to ever win 
their <CLT=cltSTRONG>Magician of the Year<CLT=cltNORMAL> award.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Fui la persona más joven en ganar 
su premio a la <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ilusionista del Año<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_007_010.stx.en: That's pretty cool.
c00_007_010.stx.es: Eso es genial.

c00_007_010.stx.en: It's all a ruse.
c00_007_010.stx.es: Todo es un engaño.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
They're keeping my magic a secret
by disguising it as tricks.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Mantienen mi magia en secreto
haciéndola pasar por trucos.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Because of this ruse, I became famous 
all over the world for performing tricks.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Por ese engaño, me hice famosa 
en todo el mundo por hacer trucos.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
But...*sniffle*...I'm not a magician...
I'm a mage... Nobody believes me...
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Pero...snif...no soy ilusionista...
Soy una maga... Nadie me cree...

c00_007_010.stx.en: There, there, don't be sad...
c00_007_010.stx.es: Ya, ya, no estés triste...

c00_007_010.stx.en:
W-Well, you could show us your magic.
Then we would believe you...
c00_007_010.stx.es:
B-Bueno, podrías mostrarnos tu magia.
Así te creeríamos...

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Oh, that's right!
Help us out with your magic!
c00_007_010.stx.es:
¡Ah, es cierto!
¡Ayúdanos con tu magia!

c00_007_010.stx.en: Take us back to when we originally—
c00_007_010.stx.es: Llévanos de vuelta a cuando—

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Magic isn't all-powerful...
I can only do so much.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
La magia no lo puede todo...
Hay un límite a lo que puedo hacer.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
I-I see...
Then...what can you do?
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Y-Ya veo...
Entonces...¿qué puedes hacer?

c00_007_010.stx.en:
I can choose the card you picked, 
pull out coins, and release doves.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Puedo adivinar la carta que escogiste, 
sacar monedas y soltar palomas.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Nyeeeh... If I get serious, I can even 
saw someone in half.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Nyeeeh... Si me pongo seria, hasta puedo 
cortar a alguien por la mitad.

c00_007_010.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>Those are just ordinary magic tricks!
c00_007_010.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>¡Esos solo son trucos de magia comunes!

Nyeeeh... This is such a pain...
Someone find the exit for me already...
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Nyeeeh... Qué lata...
Que alguien encuentre la salida por mí...

c00_007_010.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>So she doesn't wanna try to find it herself...
c00_007_010.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Así que ella no quiere buscarla...

c00_007_010.stx.en: HAAAAIYAAAAAAAHHH!!!!!
c00_007_010.stx.es: ¡¡¡¡¡HAAAAIYAAAAAAAHHH!!!!!

c00_007_010.stx.en: H-Huh?
c00_007_010.stx.es: ¿E-Eh?

c00_007_010.stx.en: I'm yelling so I can build up my spirit energy!

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Don't you know you can unlock your brain's full
potential by yelling to build up spirit energy!?
c00_007_010.stx.es:
¡¿No sabías que puedes liberar el potencial
de tu cerebro gritando para acumular energía?!

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Ah, I've heard that pro athletes do that.
It's supposed to help you focus...
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Ah, he oído que los atletas profesionales lo
hacen. Se supone que ayuda a concentrarse...

c00_007_010.stx.en:
I must be prepared for combat at all times,
just in case someone tries to attack me!
c00_007_010.stx.es:
¡Siempre debo estar lista para el combate,
por si alguien intenta atacarme!

c00_007_010.stx.en: I will protect myself with <CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
c00_007_010.stx.es: ¡Me protegeré con el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

c00_007_010.stx.en: Aikido...? Then, you're—
c00_007_010.stx.es: ¿Aikido...? Entonces, tú eres—

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Oh, yes! I'm Tenko Chabashira!
HAIYAH! The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Aikido Master<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
c00_007_010.stx.es:
¡Ah, sí! ¡Soy Tenko Chabashira!
¡HAIYAH! ¡La <CLT=cltSTRONG>Maestra de Aikido Definitiva<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Ooohh! I always imagine Aikido masters to be

c00_007_010.stx.es:
¡Ooohh! Imaginaba a los maestros de aikido
como tipos fornidos, ¡pero tú eres tan linda!

c00_007_010.stx.en: C-Cute!?
c00_007_010.stx.es: ¡¿L-Linda?!

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Aaaahhh... St-Stop iiit...
I...I-I'm not...cute...
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Aaaahhh... B-Basta...
Y...Y-Yo no...soy linda...

c00_007_010.stx.en:
My face crinkles when I suck down a shake... And
when I wipe my face, my eyelids turn inside-out.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Se me arruga la cara cuando tomo malteada...
Y al limpiarme, se me voltean los párpados.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
U-Um, I see... But I think you're cute.
Right, Shuichi?
c00_007_010.stx.es:
E-Eh, ya veo... Pero yo creo que eres linda.
¿Verdad, Shuichi?

c00_007_010.stx.en: ...Huh? Oh...right.
c00_007_010.stx.es: ...¿Eh? Ah...sí.

Wh-What's the matter?
Your face looks really intense now!
c00_007_010.stx.es:
¿Q-Qué pasa?
¡Tienes la cara muy intensa ahora!

c00_007_010.stx.en: I don't like to be praised by degenerate males.
c00_007_010.stx.es: No quiero elogios de varones degenerados.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Degenerate males? You mean men?
Are you...uncomfortable around them?
c00_007_010.stx.es:
¿Varones degenerados? ¿O sea, hombres?
¿Te...incomodan?

c00_007_010.stx.en:
It's a way bigger problem than just being
uncomfortable.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Es un problema mucho más grande que solo
sentirme incómoda.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
If any degenerate tries to touch me, my reflex is
to grab them and throw them across the room.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Si algún degenerado intenta tocarme, mi reflejo
es agarrarlo y lanzarlo al otro lado del cuarto.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
You're right... That is a way bigger problem
than just being uncomfortable around men.
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Tienes razón... Eso es un problema mucho más
grande que solo sentirte incómoda.

c00_007_010.stx.en:
Ah, by the way...what is this
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL> you mentioned?
c00_007_010.stx.es:
Ah, por cierto...¿qué es ese
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL> que mencionaste?

c00_007_010.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL> is an original form of aikido that my
master and I completely made up ourselves!
c00_007_010.stx.es:
¡El <CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL> es un aikido original que mi
maestro y yo inventamos por completo!

c00_007_010.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>O sea...tu aikido es autodidacta.

¡La única, la inigualable, la legendaria
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Inventora Definitiva<CLT=cltNORMAL> en persona—<CLT=cltSTRONG>Miu Iruma<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

c00_007_015.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>Um... I've never heard of you.
c00_007_015.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Eh... Nunca había oído de ti.

c00_007_015.stx.en: So...what kind of things do you invent?
c00_007_015.stx.es: Entonces...¿qué clase de cosas inventas?

c00_007_015.stx.en:
I make all kinds of gadgets—ones that let you
type while you sleep, read while you sleep...
c00_007_015.stx.es:
Hago toda clase de aparatos—unos para escribir
mientras duermes, para leer mientras duermes...

c00_007_015.stx.en: Even ones that let you eat while you sleep.
c00_007_015.stx.es: Hasta unos para comer mientras duermes.

c00_007_015.stx.en: Why does everything involve sleeping?
c00_007_015.stx.es: ¿Por qué todo tiene que ver con dormir?

c00_007_015.stx.en:
I was inspired after I realized how much time
people waste on sleep.
c00_007_015.stx.es:
Me inspiré cuando me di cuenta de cuánto
tiempo pierde la gente durmiendo.

c00_007_015.stx.en:
Though, this one time I invented these really
stupid eyedrop contact lenses as a gag.
c00_007_015.stx.es:
Aunque una vez inventé unos lentes de contacto
en gotas bien estúpidos, como broma.

c00_007_015.stx.en:
Wait, really? That's your invention?
Some of my friends wear them!
c00_007_015.stx.es:
Espera, ¿en serio? ¿Eso lo inventaste tú?
¡Algunas de mis amigas los usan!

c00_007_015.stx.en:
Psh! Your friends sound like total plebs!
That invention was nothing!
c00_007_015.stx.es:
¡Psh! ¡Tus amigas suenan a unas plebeyas!
¡Ese invento no era nada!

c00_007_015.stx.en:
It doesn't make you more productive while you
sleep, so it was a failure! Just like you two!
c00_007_015.stx.es:
¡No te hace más productivo mientras duermes,
así que fue un fracaso! ¡Igual que ustedes dos!

c00_007_015.stx.en:
I signed the patent rights over to some
company and never looked back.
c00_007_015.stx.es:
Le cedí la patente a una empresa
y nunca volví a pensar en eso.

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>That seems like a waste... It's way better than
your do-stuff-while-sleeping inventions...
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Qué desperdicio... Es mucho mejor que tus
inventos para hacer cosas mientras duermes...

c00_007_015.stx.en:
By the way, what were you looking for earlier?
You sounded pretty desperate to find it.
c00_007_015.stx.es:
Por cierto, ¿qué estabas buscando hace rato?
Sonabas muy desesperada por encontrarlo.

c00_007_015.stx.en:
Eh? Are you a dumbass? In a situation like
this, I gotta find some meds!
c00_007_015.stx.es:
¿Eh? ¿Eres idiota o qué? ¡En una situación
así, tengo que encontrar medicinas!

c00_007_015.stx.en: Medicine? Are you hurt or feeling sick?
c00_007_015.stx.es: ¿Medicinas? ¿Estás herida o te sientes mal?

c00_007_015.stx.en:
No, idiot! I need strong meds cuz I wanna
trip my fuckin' balls off!
c00_007_015.stx.es:
¡No, idiota! ¡Necesito medicinas fuertes porque
quiero drogarme hasta perder la cabeza!

c00_007_015.stx.en:
*sigh*... I just wanna set my mind free and
forget all about this shitty situation!
c00_007_015.stx.es:
Ay...  ¡Solo quiero liberar mi mente y
olvidarme de esta situación de mierda!

c00_007_015.stx.en:
Wait... Whaaaaaat!? You can't use drugs to
get high! You definitely shouldn't do that!
c00_007_015.stx.es:
Espera... ¡¿Quéeeee?! ¡No puedes usar medicinas
para drogarte! ¡Eso no se hace!

c00_007_015.stx.en: Heeee!
c00_007_015.stx.es: ¡Iiiiih!

c00_007_015.stx.en:
Wh-What the hell...? My genius can't be
constrained by the wisdom of the masses...
c00_007_015.stx.es:
¿Q-Qué demonios...? Mi genio no puede estar
limitado por la sabiduría de las masas...

c00_007_015.stx.en:
Besides...this place probably doesn't even
have the shit I need to get loosey-goosey...
c00_007_015.stx.es:
Además...seguro aquí ni siquiera tienen
la mierda que necesito para relajarme...

c00_007_015.stx.en:
S-So...are we cool...?
Are you...done being mad at me?
c00_007_015.stx.es:
E-Entonces...¿estamos bien...?
¿Ya...no estás enojada conmigo?

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>They say there's a fine line between genius and
insanity, but she's...definitely beyond insane.
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Dicen que entre el genio y la locura hay una
línea muy delgada, pero ella...la cruzó por mucho.

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Miu's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been
updated based on your experience with her.
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>El <CLT=cltSTRONG>Boletín<CLT=cltSYSTEM> de Miu se actualizó
con lo que viviste con ella.

c00_007_015.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>What's up with Shuichi?
c00_007_015.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>¿Qué le pasa a Shuichi?

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>He's been quiet ever since Miu mentioned
his hat... Does he not like to talk about it?
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Está callado desde que Miu mencionó su
gorra... ¿No le gusta hablar de eso?

c00_007_015.stx.en:
Eh!? Leave me alone!
I'm busy!
c00_007_015.stx.es:
¡¿Eh?! ¡Déjenme en paz!
¡Estoy ocupada!

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder if she's an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltMIND> student.
I should ask her.
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Me pregunto si es una estudiante <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitiva<CLT=cltMIND>.
Debería preguntarle.

c00_007_015.stx.en: Yes
c00_007_015.stx.es: Sí

c00_007_015.stx.en: No
c00_007_015.stx.es: No

c00_007_015.stx.en: Are you unsure of something?
c00_007_015.stx.es: ¿Tienes alguna duda?

c00_007_015.stx.en: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
c00_007_015.stx.es: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>¿Quieres salir?

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder if she's an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltMIND> student.
I should ask her.
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Me pregunto si es una estudiante <CLT=cltSTRONG>Definitiva<CLT=cltMIND>.
Debería preguntarle.

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Is this a sensor...?
This machine looks complicated.
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Esto es un sensor...?
Esta máquina se ve complicada.

c00_007_015.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>So a monitor is installed in the warehouse, too.
c00_007_015.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>Así que en el almacén también hay un monitor.

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>A shot put ball for track and field?
Does this place even have a sports stadium?
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Una bala de lanzamiento de peso?
¿Este lugar tiene estadio deportivo?

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>A remote-controlled helicopter...
What's this doing in a school warehouse?
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Un helicóptero a control remoto...
¿Qué hace esto en el almacén de una escuela?

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This...looks like a high-jump pole
for track and field...
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Esto...parece una garrocha
de atletismo...

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I didn't expect to see professional
equipment like this here.
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>No esperaba ver equipo profesional
como este aquí.

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>These mats are pretty heavy. It must be a lot
of work to carry these to the gym.
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Estas colchonetas pesan bastante. Debe costar
mucho trabajo llevarlas al gimnasio.

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>There are hurdles, too. We could hold our own
track and field meets with all this equipment.
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>También hay vallas. Con todo este equipo
podríamos hacer nuestra propia competencia.

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Disposable cameras?
I didn't know they still made these...
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Cámaras desechables?
No sabía que todavía las fabricaban...

c00_007_015.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Photo developing solution?
There are other chemicals here, too.
c00_007_015.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Revelador de fotos?
También hay otros químicos aquí.

c00_007_016.stx.en:
The toilets seem normal... But it's weird that
the plants are growing this thick...
c00_007_016.stx.es:
Los excusados parecen normales... Pero es raro
que las plantas crezcan tan espesas...

c00_007_016.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This monitor is way too high-tech to be
used in a school...
c00_007_016.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Este monitor es demasiado avanzado para
usarse en una escuela...

c00_007_017.stx.en: Heeey! Wait for meee!
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¡Oyeee! ¡Espérameee!

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Please stop!
Don't come any closer!
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¡Por favor, basta!
¡No te acerques más!

c00_007_017.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>That boy in white is chasing that other boy
in the funny clothes...
c00_007_017.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Ese chico de blanco está persiguiendo al otro
chico de la ropa rara...

c00_007_017.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>What's happening here?
c00_007_017.stx.es: <CLT=cltMIND>¿Qué está pasando aquí?

c00_007_017.stx.en:
It looks like that guy in the white
is chasing somebody...
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Parece que ese chico de blanco está
persiguiendo a alguien...

c00_007_017.stx.en:
He doesn't look like he wants to be
chased, though... Should we stop him?
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Aunque el otro no parece querer que lo
persigan... ¿Deberíamos detenerlo?

c00_007_017.stx.en:
An evil, secret organization with
over 10,000 members...?
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¿Una organización secreta malvada con
más de 10,000 miembros...?

c00_007_017.stx.en:
It's a lie.
I don't think you should worry about it.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Es mentira.
No creo que debas preocuparte por eso.

c00_007_017.stx.en: C'mooon! Wait up!
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¡Ándaleee! ¡Espérame!

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Lemme touch your body a little! I've always
wanted to be friends with a robot!
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¡Déjame tocarte un poquito! ¡Siempre quise
ser amigo de un robot!

c00_007_017.stx.en: What? A robot!?
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¿Qué? ¡¿Un robot?!

c00_007_017.stx.en:
...What is it?
Are you another robophobe?
c00_007_017.stx.es:
...¿Qué pasa?
¿Tú también eres robofóbica?

c00_007_017.stx.en:
I have a recording function. If you make any
robophobic remarks, I will see you in court.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Tengo función de grabación. Si haces algún
comentario robofóbico, nos vemos en la corte.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Wait...you're a robot!?
Are you, for reals, a robot!?
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Espera...¡¿eres un robot?!
¡¿En serio eres un robot?!

c00_007_017.stx.en: A-Are you...one of the Monokubs—
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¿E-Eres...uno de los Monokubs—

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Do not compare me to those toys!
I am not just any old robot!
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¡No me compares con esos juguetes!
¡No soy un robot cualquiera!

c00_007_017.stx.en:
I am K1-B0, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Robot<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
But please, address me as Keebo!
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¡Soy K1-B0, el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Robot Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
¡Pero, por favor, llámenme Keebo!

c00_007_017.stx.en: <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Robot<CLT=cltNORMAL>...?
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¿<CLT=cltSTRONG>Robot Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>...?

c00_007_017.stx.en:
That's not faaair! You can't be the only
one who gets to show off!
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¡Eso no es justooo! ¡No puedes ser el único
que se luzca!

c00_007_017.stx.en: I'll introduce myself, too!
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¡Yo también me voy a presentar!

c00_007_017.stx.en: Oh, um...go ahead.
c00_007_017.stx.es: Ah, eh...adelante.

c00_007_017.stx.en: I'm Kokichi Oma, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Supreme Leader<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¡Soy Kokichi Oma, el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Líder Supremo Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

c00_007_017.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>A robot and...supreme leader?
Neither of them make any sense.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>¿Un robot y...un líder supremo?
Ninguno de los dos tiene sentido.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
By the way, I learned the hard way that a
robot's breath smells like gasoline.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Por cierto, aprendí por las malas que el
aliento de un robot huele a gasolina.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
My breath does not smell like gasoline!
I am powered by electricity!
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¡Mi aliento no huele a gasolina!
¡Funciono con electricidad!

c00_007_017.stx.en: Nee-heehee...I'm just kidding.
c00_007_017.stx.es: Nishishi...solo bromeo.

c00_007_017.stx.en: ...You're not funny.
c00_007_017.stx.es: ...No eres gracioso.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Of course you don't think I'm funny. Robots
can't understand human humor to begin with!
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Claro que no te parezco gracioso. ¡Los robots
ni siquiera entienden el humor humano!

c00_007_017.stx.en:
D-Don't mock me! I have studied the
complete history of stand-up comedy!
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¡N-No te burles de mí! ¡Estudié toda la
historia de la comedia en vivo!

c00_007_017.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I think you should've just watched stand-up
comedy instead of studying it...
c00_007_017.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Creo que deberías haber visto comedia en
vivo en lugar de estudiarla...

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Plus, I may have the appearance of a robot,
but I am a high school student just like you.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Además, puede que parezca un robot, pero
soy estudiante de preparatoria como ustedes.

c00_007_017.stx.en: You're a high school student?
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¿Eres estudiante de preparatoria?

c00_007_017.stx.en:
I was created by Professor Idabashi, the
leading authority in the field of robotics...
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Me creó el profesor Idabashi, la máxima
autoridad en el campo de la robótica...

c00_007_017.stx.en:
He installed in me a "<CLT=cltSTRONG>strong AI<CLT=cltNORMAL>," capable of
learning and maturing like a human brain.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Me instaló una "<CLT=cltSTRONG>IA fuerte<CLT=cltNORMAL>", capaz de
aprender y madurar como un cerebro humano.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
That's why, at the time of my creation, I
didn't know anything. I was like a baby...
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Por eso, cuando me crearon, no sabía
nada. Era como un bebé...

c00_007_017.stx.en:
But the professor raised me like I was his
own child.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Pero el profesor me crió como si fuera
su propio hijo.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
He taught me so many things...
Until finally, he enrolled me in high school.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Me enseñó muchísimas cosas...
Hasta que por fin me inscribió en la preparatoria.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
And now I stand here before you all!
See? I'm just like everyone else!
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¡Y ahora estoy aquí frente a ustedes!
¿Ven? ¡Soy igual que todos!

c00_007_017.stx.en: Hey, do robots have dicks?
c00_007_017.stx.es: Oye, ¿los robots tienen pito?

c00_007_017.stx.en: Please do not ask ridiculous questions!
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¡Por favor, no hagas preguntas ridículas!

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Nee-heehee... I only asked because your
backstory is pretty flaccid for a robot.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Nishishi... Solo pregunté porque tu historia
está muy flácida para ser de un robot.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Well, I can see how being a <CLT=cltSTRONG>robot<CLT=cltMIND> might be
enough to be called the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Robot<CLT=cltMIND>...
c00_007_017.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Bueno, supongo que ser un <CLT=cltSTRONG>robot<CLT=cltMIND> basta
para que te llamen el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Robot Definitivo<CLT=cltMIND>...

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Hey, Kokichi? I don't really understand your
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Supreme Leader<CLT=cltNORMAL> talent...
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Oye, ¿Kokichi? No entiendo muy bien tu talento
de <CLT=cltSTRONG>Líder Supremo Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

c00_007_017.stx.en:
...Oh. I'm just the supreme leader of an
evil secret organization. That's all.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
...Ah. Solo soy el líder supremo de una
organización secreta malvada. Nada más.

c00_007_017.stx.en: What?
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¿Qué?

c00_007_017.stx.en:
I gotta say, it's pretty impressive.
My organization has over 10,000 members!
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Tengo que decirlo, es bastante impresionante.
¡Mi organización tiene más de 10,000 miembros!

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Seriously? The supreme leader of an evil
secret organiza—
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¿En serio? ¿El líder supremo de una
organización secreta malva—

c00_007_017.stx.en: Who knows? I am a liar, after all.
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¿Quién sabe? Después de todo, soy un mentiroso.

c00_007_017.stx.en: Huh? So you were lying just now?
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¿Eh? ¿O sea que hace rato mentías?

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Well, I am the supreme leader of an evil
secret organization. That part was true!
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Bueno, sí soy el líder supremo de una
organización secreta malvada. ¡Eso sí era cierto!

c00_007_017.stx.en: So...were you lying or not?
c00_007_017.stx.es: Entonces...¿mentías o no?

c00_007_017.stx.en: Nee-heehee... I'm not telling youuuuu.
c00_007_017.stx.es: Nishishi... No te lo voy a deciiiiir.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Ah, by the way...
what is the name of that organization?
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Ah, por cierto...
¿cómo se llama esa organización?

c00_007_017.stx.en:
It's a secret. Y'know, cuz it's a secret
organization.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Es secreto. Ya sabes, porque es una
organización secreta.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
But I've never heard of such a large
secret organization like that...
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Pero nunca había oído de una organización
secreta tan grande...

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Of course you haven't. Because it's
a secret organization.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Claro que no. Porque es una
organización secreta.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Hey... Everything he's said so far has sounded
like a lie, so that's gotta be a lie too, right?
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Oye... Todo lo que ha dicho suena a mentira,
así que eso también debe ser mentira, ¿no?

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Just leave him alone. Everything he has
been saying has been a lie.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Ignórenlo. Todo lo que ha dicho
ha sido mentira.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
...He's a far more suspicious person than
I am, that's for sure.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
...Eso sí, es una persona mucho más
sospechosa que yo.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Well, of course you're not a suspicious person,
because robots aren't people, silly.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Bueno, claro que no eres una persona sospechosa,
porque los robots no son personas, tontito.

c00_007_017.stx.en: Grgh...!
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¡Grgh...!

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Oh, you mad? Are you gonna hit me
with a rocket punch?
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¿Uy, te enojaste? ¿Me vas a dar
un puñetazo cohete?

c00_007_017.stx.en: I don't have that function!
c00_007_017.stx.es: ¡No tengo esa función!

c00_007_017.stx.en: Aw maaan, you're boring.
c00_007_017.stx.es: Ay, quéee aburrido eres.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>What a weird boy...
He's like a mischievous little kid...
c00_007_017.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Qué chico tan raro...
Es como un niño travieso...

c00_007_017.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This is no time to be joking around. Unless...
he really is an evil supreme leader?
c00_007_017.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>No es momento para bromas. A menos que...
¿de verdad sea un líder supremo malvado?

c00_007_017.stx.en:

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Who creates a robot without a rocket punch?
Why do you even exist?
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¿Quién crea un robot sin puñetazo cohete?
¿Para qué existes siquiera?

c00_007_017.stx.en:
Please stop!
Don't come any closer!
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¡Por favor, basta!
¡No te acerques más!

c00_007_017.stx.en:
I may have the appearance of a robot, but
I am a high school student just like you.
c00_007_017.stx.es:
Puede que parezca un robot, pero
soy estudiante de preparatoria como ustedes.

c00_007_017.stx.en:
From one high school student to another,
I hope we can all get along!
c00_007_017.stx.es:
¡De estudiante de preparatoria a estudiante
de preparatoria, espero que nos llevemos bien!

c00_007_017.stx.en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Normal schools don't have monitors like
this, right?
c00_007_017.stx.es:
<CLT=cltMIND>Las escuelas normales no tienen monitores
así, ¿verdad?

c00_007_018.stx.en:
Huh? No...
Why do you ask?
Well...you came all the way back here...
Ooh, so that's what you meant.

Hm, your deductions are pretty sharp. No wonder
they call you the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
c00_007_018.stx.es:
Mmm, tus deducciones son agudas. Con razón
te llaman el <CLT=cltSTRONG>Detective Definitivo<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

c00_007_018.stx.en:
Ah, not really... I wouldn't call
this a deduction.
c00_007_018.stx.es:
Ah, no tanto... Yo no llamaría
a esto una deducción.

c00_007_018.stx.en:
...There's no point staying here forever.
We should go somewhere else.
c00_007_018.stx.es:
...No tiene caso quedarnos aquí para siempre.
Deberíamos ir a otro lado.

c00_007_018.stx.en:
You're right. It sounds like there are other
Ultimate students. Let's go talk to them.
c00_007_018.stx.es:
Tienes razón. Parece que hay otros estudiantes
Definitivos. Vamos a hablar con ellos.

c00_007_018.stx.en: <CLT=cltMIND>We woke up inside of these lockers...

Why were we put inside lockers?
I don't understand...
c00_007_018.stx.es:
¿Por qué nos metieron en casilleros?
No entiendo...

<CLT=cltMIND>This monitor is way too high-tech to be
used in a school...

<CLT=cltMIND>Este monitor es demasiado avanzado para
usarse en una escuela...
